national_news.title: IWAI Showcases Bogibeel IWT Terminal Operations along National Waterway-2
bullets: Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) outlined cargo and multimodal capabilities of the Bogibeel IWT Terminal on Brahmaputra's National Waterway-2 (NW-2).
The Bogibeel terminal features a berthing capacity for 1,000 MT vessels and handles an annual cargo capacity of 6 lakh MT, serving petroleum, coal, tea, and Over-Dimensional Cargo (ODC).
NW-2 stretches 891 km from the Bangladesh border to Sadiya; lessons from its development are being adapted for Odisha's National Waterway-5 (NW-5) on the Brahmani–Mahanadi river system.

national_news.title: IAF and Japan's JASDF Conduct Joint Air Exercise 'Veer Guardian 2026' in Jodhpur
bullets: Indian Air Force Chief Air Chief Marshal AP Singh and Japan Air Self-Defense Force Chief General Takehiro Morita flew in a formation sortie in India's indigenous LCA Tejas during 'Veer Guardian 2026' in Jodhpur.
This marks the first time Japanese fighter aircraft (F-2A) operated from Indian soil as part of a bilateral defense exercise.
The 14-day exercise featured advanced operational missions involving IAF's LCA Tejas, Su-30MKI, and Rafale alongside Japanese F-2A fighters.

national_news.title: Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh Organized Nationwide Under Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan
bullets: The Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh is being organized across 1,067 locations nationwide by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to eradicate drug abuse among youth.
The initiative is part of the 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat - 100 Weeks Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan' youth mobilization campaign.
Programs are being held across 471 District MY Bharat Offices and 596 locations of partner organizations, featuring pledges, signature campaigns, street plays, and youth discussions.

national_news.title: Indian Air Force to Host Mega Air Show in Varanasi
bullets: The Indian Air Force (IAF) is organizing its first-ever three-day aerial display over the Ganges in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.
The air show features over 36 aircraft including Rafale fighters, Tejas jets, Suryakiran aerobatic team, Rudra helicopters, and C-295 transport aircraft.
Namo Ghat has been designated as the primary control center for coordinating operations alongside Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport.

national_news.title: Nagpur's Indora–Dighori Flyover Inaugurated
bullets: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari and Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the Indora Chowk–Dighori Chowk Flyover in Nagpur.
The Rs 998-crore project developed by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) is the city's largest and costliest flyover.
The 8.9-kilometre elevated corridor is built using Ultra High Performance Fibre Reinforced Concrete technology to decongest key east Nagpur corridors.

national_news.title: Indian Defence Service of Engineers Celebrates 77th Raising Day
bullets: Officers of the Indian Defence Service of Engineers (IDSE) cadre under the Military Engineer Services (MES), Ministry of Defence, celebrated their 77th Raising Day at Palam Air Force Station.
The central theme of the one-day conference held on September 17, 2026, was 'Ethics, Accountability and Excellence towards achieving the aim of Viksit Bharat @ 2047.'
Discussions emphasized transparency in public procurement, adoption of the Electronic Measurement Book, and the role of Integrity Pacts in infrastructure projects.

national_news.title: Northeast Education Conclave 2026 Focuses on NEP 2020 Implementation
bullets: The two-day Northeast Education Conclave 2026 concluded at Chümoukedima in Nagaland, organized by the Government of Nagaland in collaboration with the Union Ministry of Education.
The conclave focused on effective implementation of NEP 2020, highlighting over Rs 21,000 crore invested in the Northeast education sector over the past decade.
Key targets include achieving a 50 percent Gross Enrolment Ratio in higher education by 2035 and transforming brain drain into brain circulation through enhanced skill development.

national_news.title: Nepalese Finance Minister Calls for Renewed India-Nepal Partnership at RIS Seminar
bullets: Nepalese Finance Minister Dr Swarnim Wagle advocated for renewed India-Nepal partnership focusing on connectivity, economic cooperation, and pre-disaster investments.
The seminar was organized by the Research and Information System for Developing Countries (RIS) in New Delhi.
Discussions highlighted cooperation in cross-border electricity trade, joint projects, and India's swift relief assistance during recent flash floods in Nepal.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses International Conference on Future of Environment and Climate Dynamics
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the two-day International Conference on the Future of Environment and Climate Dynamics in New Delhi, organized by the National Green Tribunal (NGT).
Emphasized that India's per capita carbon emissions are less than half the global average, and highlighted India as the only G20 nation to meet its COP-21 Paris Summit commitments ahead of schedule.

Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav stated that non-fossil fuel sources now account for over 54% of India's total installed electricity capacity, placing India third globally in installed renewable capacity.

national_news.title: PM Modi Distributes Over 51,000 Appointment Letters at 20th Rozgar Mela
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi distributed over 51,000 appointment letters at the 20th Rozgar Mela held across 45 locations, bringing the cumulative total of appointments under the initiative to approximately 12.75 lakh.

Highlighted the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana, which has an outlay of around ₹1 lakh crore and aims to facilitate the entry of nearly 2 crore youth into the formal workforce with a first-job incentive of up to ₹15,000.

Noted that India stands as the world's third-largest startup ecosystem, with nearly 50% of recognized startups located in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities, alongside signing Free Trade Agreements with nearly 40 countries.

national_news.title: India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 to Focus on Six Key Ecosystem Pillars
bullets: Electronics and IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced at Semicon India 2026 that India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 (Semicon 2.0) focuses on six key pillars: chip design, materials, fabrication, ATMP, R&D, and storage.

India has trained 70,000 semiconductor design engineers in four years toward its 10-year target of 85,000, with around 400 engineering colleges granted access to Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools.
The semiconductor initiative aims to generate over one lakh jobs and build a sustained 20-year roadmap for the national semiconductor ecosystem.

national_news.title: India and Nepal Discuss Measures to Facilitate Greater Market Access and Trade
bullets: India and Nepal held a two-day meeting of the Inter-Governmental Sub-Committee (IGSC) on Trade, Transit, and Cooperation to Control Unauthorised Trade.
Discussions covered market access, Customs and trade facilitation, food safety, border infrastructure, and rail and road connectivity.
The Indian delegation was led by Joint Secretary Ujjwal Kumar Ghosh, while the Nepali delegation was led by Joint Secretary Buddha Bahadur Gurung.

national_news.title: India Emerging as Trusted Partner in Global Semiconductor Industry: Ashwini Vaishnaw
bullets: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated at Semicon India 2026 in New Delhi that India is emerging as a trusted partner in the global semiconductor supply chain.
Under the skilling initiative, India has trained 70,000 semiconductor design engineers in four years, moving towards its target of 85,000 over ten years.
The India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 (Semicon 2.0) focuses on six key pillars: chip design, materials, fabrication, ATMP, research and development, and storage.

national_news.title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme Completes Three Years with 30 Lakh Artisans Registered
bullets: The Ministry of MSME celebrated the 3rd Anniversary of the PM Vishwakarma Scheme in Kolkata, West Bengal, marking three years since its launch on September 17, 2023.
The scheme has registered over 30 lakh traditional artisans and craftspeople, providing skill training, modern tools, institutional credit, and market linkages.
West Bengal officially onboarded the implementation of the scheme, receiving over 7 lakh applications from local artisans.

national_news.title: Union Minister B. L. Verma Highlights NAMASTE Scheme and Welfare Measures in Budaun
bullets: Union Minister of State for Social Justice and Empowerment reviewed the 'Swachhata Hi Seva' campaign and reiterated the government's commitment to 'Vanchiton Ko Variyata'.
Highlighted the National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) Scheme aimed at ensuring dignity and safety of sanitation workers.
Reported that 90,157 sewer and septic tank workers and over 5 lakh waste pickers have been profiled under the scheme.

national_news.title: Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya and Tata Electronics Partner for Semiconductor Talent
bullets: Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya and Tata Electronics signed an MoU to develop industry-ready talent for semiconductor and infrastructure manufacturing.
Partnership includes multi-party frameworks involving L&T EduTech and Jacobs Solutions to provide subject matter expertise.
Focuses on academic curriculum development, joint certification programs, and skilling in semiconductor facility engineering, logistics, and supply chain.

national_news.title: Steel Cutting Ceremony Held for Indian Navy's Second Next Generation Missile Vessel at Cochin Shipyard
bullets: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) performed the steel cutting for the Indian Navy's second Next Generation Missile Vessel (NGMV) in Kochi.
The project is part of a March 2023 contract valued at Rs 9,805 crore to build six advanced missile vessels.
These 89-metre vessels are designed to achieve speeds of 35 knots, feature indigenous role-defining equipment, and will be powered by GE Aerospace LM2500 engines.

national_news.title: Union Minister for Education Launches 6-Month Bridge Course in Primary Teacher Education
bullets: Union Minister for Education launched a six-month Certificate (Bridge) Course in Primary Teacher Education (PTE) for in-service primary school teachers holding a B.Ed. degree.

Implemented through the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) under the NCTE framework, the Open and Distance Learning (ODL) course includes 6 theory courses, 10 days of online contact classes, and 20 days of school-based experience.

Designed pursuant to the Supreme Court judgment (08.04.2024) in Devesh Sharma vs. Union of India, it targets teachers appointed between June 28, 2018, and August 11, 2023, allowing public examinations in any of the 22 Eighth Schedule languages.

national_news.title: HAL Hands Over LCA Tejas Trainers, HTT-40, and Dhruv NG Helicopters
bullets: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) is handing over LCA Tejas Final Operational Clearance (FOC) Twin Seater Trainers and HTT-40 Basic Trainer Aircraft to the Indian Air Force (IAF).
HAL is also delivering Dhruv Next Generation (NG) helicopters to civil operator Pawan Hans Limited (PHL) in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
The induction marks a significant milestone in advancing domestic aerospace design, indigenous defense production, and self-reliance in military and civil aviation.

national_news.title: MSME Ministry Celebrates 3rd Anniversary of PM Vishwakarma Scheme
bullets: The Ministry of MSME celebrated the 3rd anniversary of the PM Vishwakarma Scheme at Dhono Dhanyo Auditorium in Kolkata, West Bengal, chaired by Union Minister Jitan Ram Manjhi.

Launched on September 17, 2023, the scheme aims to empower traditional craftspeople with skill development, modern toolkits, institutional credit, and market linkages, accumulating over 30 lakh registrations.
West Bengal officially onboarded the implementation of the central scheme in May, generating over 7 lakh artisan applications from the state.

national_news.title: Meghalaya hosts North East Inter-State Badminton Championship as precursor to National Games 2027
bullets: The North East Zone Inter-State Badminton Championship 2026 is being held at the Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Sports Complex in Shillong.
The tournament serves as the official qualifying ground for team events of the upcoming 39th National Games.
Meghalaya highlighted its Meghalaya Outstanding Direct Appointment Policy, which guarantees direct government jobs to state athletes winning medals at major events.

national_news.title: Nationwide Seva Sankalp Abhiyaan begins marking 25 years of PM Modi's public service
bullets: BJP's month-long nationwide 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyaan' commenced to mark the completion of 25 years of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's public life and service.
The campaign runs until the 17th of next month, with the opening day observed as 'Seva Diwas' featuring nationwide blood donation camps.
The initiative reinforces the national goal of achieving 'Viksit Bharat' by 2047 under the leadership of Prime Minister Modi.

national_news.title: India Asserts Right to Protect Energy Security Amid US Sanctions Bill
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs affirmed that India will take all necessary measures to ensure energy security for its 140 crore citizens through diversified crude sourcing.
Statement comes after the US House of Representatives passed a bill authorizing up to 100% tariffs on countries procuring Russian crude oil.
The proposed US legislation targets Russia's energy sector, its shadow fleet of vessels, and seeks to enforce restrictions on major buyers like India and China.

national_news.title: India and Bhutan Launch Phase 2 of Cross-Border UPI Payments
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar launched the second phase of international UPI in Bhutan, completing two-way digital payment connectivity between both nations.
India extended the Nehru Wangchuck Scholarship Scheme for Bhutanese students and handed over 54 Made-in-India electric vehicles to support e-mobility in Bhutan.
Inaugurated the 65-bed Gyaltsuen Jetsun Pema Mother and Child Hospital in Mongar and laid the foundation stone for the 500 KW Lunana Hydropower Project.

national_news.title: PIB, NCB and MHA Detail Anti-Drug Operations and Institutional Expansion
bullets: NCB institutional capacity expanded with manpower increasing from 1,107 to 1,630, zonal units rising from 13 to 36, and regional offices from 3 to 7.
Properties and assets worth ₹3,992 crore have been frozen or seized since 2019, while 128 illegal clandestine laboratories were dismantled up to July 2026.
Major anti-drug operations highlighted include Operation Sagar Manthan (maritime smuggling), Operation Crystal Fortress, Operation Ragepill, and Operation White Strike.

national_news.title: Vice President Leads 79th Hyderabad Liberation Day Commemoration
bullets: The Union Ministry of Culture officially commemorated the 79th Hyderabad Liberation Day at Parade Grounds, Secunderabad, marking the princely state's integration into India via Operation Polo on September 17, 1948.
Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan paid homage at the War Memorial and honored Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel along with regional freedom fighters Ramji Gond, Turrebaz Khan, and Komaram Bheem.
The Central Bureau of Communication under the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting organized a research-based photo exhibition documenting the historic struggle and unification.

national_news.title: NCB Shifts Strategy to Network-Centric Model Under Vision Document 2026–29
bullets: The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) announced a transition from a seizure-centric to a network-centric model to choke drug financing and dismantle trafficking infrastructure.
The strategy is aligned with the Vision Document on Narcotics Control 2026–29, which sets a three-year roadmap to make India drug-free by July 2029.
The policy focuses on four pillars: intelligence enforcement, synthetic/precursor drug control, demand/harm reduction, and capacity building via Nasha Mukt Bharat Mitras.

national_news.title: Government Exempts Small Exporters from RCMC Requirement to Reduce Compliance Burden
bullets: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry exempted small-value export consignments up to Rs 3 lakh from the Registration-cum-Membership Certificate (RCMC) requirement.
The measure aims to reduce compliance burdens, facilitating micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), artisans, and first-time exporters.
Consignments exceeding Rs 3 lakh will continue to require a valid RCMC or Certificate of Registration as applicable.

national_news.title: PM Modi Chairs Semiconductor Roundtable to Shape India's Technology Future
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the Semiconductor Roundtable with leading global and domestic CEOs in New Delhi.
Discussions focused on scaling up the semiconductor ecosystem under India Semiconductor Mission 2.0, covering manufacturing, design, R&D, and skilling.
The Prime Minister emphasized fostering emerging technologies like AI and Quantum Computing, aiming to train one crore people in AI.

national_news.title: COAS General Dhiraj Seth Embarks on 3-Day Russia Visit to Boost Defence Ties
bullets: Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) General Dhiraj Seth undertook an official three-day visit to Russia from September 16 to 18, 2026, to strengthen bilateral military-to-military cooperation.
Key interactions included meetings with Colonel General Andrei Nikolayevich Mordvichev, Commander-in-Chief of Russian Land Forces, and Deputy Defence Minister Vasily Sergeyevich Osmakov in Moscow.

The visit emphasized co-development and co-production of defence equipment, building upon joint ventures like T-90 tanks, Su-30 MKI assembly, BrahMos exports, and the commissioning of stealth frigate INS Tamal in Kaliningrad.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Raises EPFO Wage Ceiling to Rs 25,000 Per Month
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved increasing the mandatory coverage wage ceiling under the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 per month.
Proposed by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, the move will extend statutory provident fund, EPS pension, and EDLI insurance protection to an additional 51 lakh workers.
This marks the first wage ceiling revision since September 2014, with the estimated annual government outgo rising to approximately Rs 11,339 crore.

national_news.title: Veteran Actor Anant Nag Conferred Dadasaheb Phalke Award 2024
bullets: Veteran Kannada actor Anant Nag has been named the recipient of the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024 for his contribution to Indian cinema over nearly five decades.
The award will be presented during the 72nd National Film Awards ceremony scheduled to take place in Kevadia, Gujarat.
With a career spanning over 300 films across Kannada, Hindi, Marathi, Telugu, Malayalam, and English, Nag was a key figure in India's parallel cinema movement during the 1970s.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog Releases India Electric Mobility Index 2025; Delhi Tops
bullets: NITI Aayog released the second edition of the India Electric Mobility Index (IEMI) 2025, with Delhi ranking as the top performer among States and UTs.
The index evaluates States and UTs across 16 indicators under three core themes: Transport Electrification Progress, Charging Infrastructure Readiness, and EV Research & Innovation Status.
Following Delhi, the top-performing states and UTs include Maharashtra, Karnataka, Chandigarh, and Goa, with the highest score increasing from 77 in 2024 to 84 in 2025.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi to Inaugurate SEMICON India 2026 in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the SEMICON India 2026 conference at Yashobhoomi, Dwarka, showcasing India's growing semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem.
The theme for SEMICON India 2026 is 'Silicon to Systems: Building the Ecosystem', focusing on domestic chip fabrication and supply chain development.
The three-day global summit brings together international chipmakers, policymakers, and tech investors to strengthen India's position in the $4.3 trillion global electronics market.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves ₹10,998 Crore Varuna Elevated Corridor Project
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved the 43.218-km Varuna Elevated Corridor in Varanasi, budgeted at ₹10,998 crore to connect NH-31 directly with the Varanasi Ring Road.
The 6/4-lane project is being developed by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways as part of the Varanasi Decongestion Plan.
Designed for operating speeds of 80–100 kmph, the corridor will slash travel time between Varanasi Junction and Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport from 60 minutes to 20 minutes.

national_news.title: Finance Ministry Issues Revised MDR Framework for UPI Payments Under PSS Act
bullets: The Finance Ministry announced that Person-to-Person (P2P) UPI transactions will remain completely free with zero platform fees or hidden charges allowed for app providers.

Under the amended Payment and Settlement Systems (PSS) Act, 2007, a 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) applies only to Person-to-Merchant (P2M) transactions above ₹2,000, capped at ₹300 for high-value transactions of ₹75,000 and above.

Small merchants receiving up to ₹1 lakh per month retain mandatory zero MDR, while sectors like Railways, fuel, telecom, insurance, and agriculture inputs pay a flat ₹5 MDR for transactions exceeding ₹2,000.

national_news.title: SPROUT Facility Inaugurated at BRIC-NIPGR Under BioE3 Policy
bullets: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh inaugurated the SPROUT facility at the BRIC-National Institute of Plant Genome Research (NIPGR) in New Delhi.
SPROUT (SpeedSeed Phenotyping and Resource Optimization for Unified Trait Analysis) is a controlled-environment facility for high-throughput phenotyping and precision stress screening.
Aligned with the BioE3 policy, the facility bridges plant genomics with trait evaluation to develop climate-resilient crops, with an initial focus on chickpea.

national_news.title: Govt Promotes Sports for Nation-Building Under 'Viksit Bharat 2047'
bullets: Union MoS for Youth Affairs and Sports Raksha Khadse emphasized sports development as a key pillar for achieving the 'Viksit Bharat 2047' goal.
Highlighted the 'Yuva Connect' initiative, designed to seamlessly integrate sports with education across educational institutions.
Emphasized talent identification in remote regions, promotion of women in sports, and systematic support under the Khelo India programme.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Addresses DRDO-Industry Synergy Meet 'VIMARSH 2026'
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed 'VIMARSH 2026' in New Delhi, calling for seamless co-development and co-production between the Armed Forces, R&D bodies, and private industry.
Highlighted major policy drives including Positive Indigenisation Lists, iDEX, ADITI schemes, and the 25% allocation of the Defence R&D budget to private enterprise.
DRDO handed over nine Transfer of Technology (ToT) agreements to 13 manufacturing partners and signed an agreement with QCI for SAMAR 2.0 (System for Advance Manufacturing Assessment and Rating).

national_news.title: Six States Sign Agreement for Kishau Multipurpose Dam Project
bullets: Chief Ministers of six states—Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Delhi—signed an agreement for the Kishau Multipurpose Dam Project to rejuvenate the Yamuna River.
The project has been declared a National Project, with the Central Government bearing 90% of the financial burden and the remaining 10% split among the participating states.
The agreement marks the resolution of another major inter-state river water sharing issue, joining earlier settlements like the Lakhwar Dam and Ken-Betwa Link projects.

national_news.title: Finance Ministry Clarifies MDR Structure for UPI Under PSS Act
bullets: The Ministry of Finance clarified that Person-to-Person (P2P) UPI transactions remain completely free, while a 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) applies only to Person-to-Merchant (P2M) transactions exceeding ₹2,000.

Under notifications issued via the Payment and Settlement Systems (PSS) Act, 2007, small merchants receiving up to ₹1 lakh monthly via QR codes under P2PM classification enjoy zero MDR, with high-value transactions (₹75,000+) capped at ₹300.
Essential sectors including Railways, telecom, insurance, fuel, and agricultural inputs will attract a flat MDR of ₹5 for P2M transactions above ₹2,000.

national_news.title: India and China Emphasize 'Three Mutuals' at BRICS Summit
bullets: PM Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping met on the sidelines of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, reiterating that bilateral ties must be guided by 'three mutuals': mutual respect, mutual interest, and mutual sensitivity.

The Ministry of External Affairs addressed security in international waterways following an attack on MT El Gaia off Oman's coast involving 14 Indian seafarers, underscoring India's commitment to safe navigation.
India reaffirmed its long-standing energy cooperation with Russia, citing the Kudankulam project as a successful flagship initiative in the nuclear sector.

national_news.title: Department of Justice Organises Tele-Law Workshop Under DISHA 2.0 Scheme
bullets: The Department of Justice, Ministry of Law and Justice, conducted an awareness workshop on Tele-Law services under the DISHA 2.0 (Designing Innovative Solutions for Holistic Access to Justice) scheme at Nuh, Haryana.
The workshop focused on advancing access to legal aid through technology-enabled platforms, including the Tele-Law Portal, Nyaya Bandhu, VIDHI-Sanjeevani, and the AI-enabled 'Nyaya Setu' chatbot.
Common Services Centres (CSCs) and Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLEs) were highlighted as primary grassroots access points for facilitating legal advice to citizens in rural and underserved areas.

national_news.title: National Engineers’ Day Celebrated to Honor Bharat Ratna M Visvesvaraya
bullets: National Engineers’ Day is observed across India annually on 15th September to mark the birth anniversary of legendary engineer Bharat Ratna Mokshagundam Visvesvaraya.
The day recognizes the pivotal contributions of engineers towards national infrastructure, technological innovation, and building a 'Viksit Bharat'.
Leaders across the nation paid tributes to M Visvesvaraya, highlighting his enduring legacy of excellence, discipline, and public service.

national_news.title: Department of Rural Development and PFRDA sign MoU to launch Pension Sakhis
bullets: The Department of Rural Development (DoRD) and PFRDA signed an MoU to create community-based 'Pension Sakhis' across rural India.
Leverages the network of Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana: National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM), including BC Sakhis and self-help groups (SHGs).
Aims to take pension awareness, financial literacy, and retirement security like NPS to doorstep of rural households and Lakhpati Didis.

national_news.title: CJI Surya Kant highlights robust mechanism for addressing complaints against judges
bullets: CJI Surya Kant described the mechanism to address complaints against judges in Supreme Court and High Courts as robust, responsive, and timely.
Delivered the keynote address at the 6th Ram Jethmalani Memorial Lecture in New Delhi, focusing on transparency and public trust.
Emphasized that fair, informed, and constructive critique of judicial functioning is a legitimate and necessary feature of a vibrant constitutional democracy.

national_news.title: World Circular Economy Forum 2026 begins in Gandhinagar, Gujarat
bullets: The World Circular Economy Forum (WCEF) 2026 is being held at Mahatma Mandir in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, marking its first edition in South Asia.
Jointly inaugurated by Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav and Gujarat CM Bhupendra Patel under the theme 'Circular Economy: Transition for People and Prosperity.'
Organized jointly by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, CPCB, Finnish Innovation Fund Sitra, and the Government of Gujarat.

national_news.title: SKUAST-K Scholar Wins National Bio Entrepreneurship Competition 2026
bullets: Bushra Naaz, a PhD scholar from SKUAST-K, won the prestigious National Bio Entrepreneurship Competition (NBEC) 2026 held in Bengaluru.
She was awarded a cash prize of ₹1 lakh for her pioneering research on plant-based meat analogues using fava bean.
The competition evaluated over 3,200 registrations across 34 States and UTs on parameters such as scientific validity, novelty, and commercial business potential.

national_news.title: Defence Ministry Reports Reduction in PLA Troop Deployment Along LAC in 2025
bullets: The Ministry of Defence annual report stated that China reduced its People’s Liberation Army (PLA) force deployment along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in 2025.
Bilateral engagement resumed through the Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination (WMCC) and Special Representative talks on the boundary question.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to China for the SCO Summit in Tianjin in August 2025 further reinforced improving bilateral relations and border stability.

national_news.title: DRI Busts Pakistan-Origin Dry Dates Import Syndicate under 'Operation Deep Manifest'
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized over 362 metric tonnes of Pakistan-origin dry dates in Nashik under 'Operation Deep Manifest'.
The illicit consignment was routed through Jebel Ali Port in the UAE using falsified paperwork to mask Karachi Port as the true origin.
The Government of India imposed a complete prohibition on direct or indirect imports from Pakistan effective May 2, 2025, via DGFT Notification No. 06/2025-26.

national_news.title: Defence Ministry Annual Report 2025-26 Highlights J&K Security, LAC Stability, and Domestic Defense Procurement
bullets: The Defence Ministry's annual report states that security in Jammu and Kashmir remains firmly under control with a significant decline in violence and zero stone pelting incidents.
The report noted a reduction in China's PLA deployment along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) and northern borders following diplomatic and military-level talks.
Approximately 75% of total defence procurement expenditure was directed toward domestic sources to reduce foreign import dependency and boost the local industrial base.

national_news.title: India Defeats Sri Lanka by 72 Runs to Win Record 8th Women's Asia Cup Title
bullets: The Indian Women's cricket team defeated Sri Lanka by 72 runs in the final in Dubai to secure a record-extending eighth Asia Cup title.
Shafali Verma was awarded Player of the Match after building a 129-run opening stand with Smriti Mandhana to post 183/5.
Bowlers Shree Charani (4/...) and Deepti Sharma (3/...) dismissed Sri Lanka for 111 runs in 19.4 overs to complete the win.

national_news.title: Hindi Diwas Celebrated; 6th All India Official Language Conference Held in Navi Mumbai
bullets: Hindi Diwas marks the adoption of Hindi in Devanagari script as India's official language by the Constituent Assembly on September 14, 1949.
The Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, organized the 6th All India Rajbhasha Sammelan (Official Language Conference) in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah presented the ‘Rajbhasha Gaurav’ and ‘Rajbhasha Kirti’ Awards for 2025-26 during the inaugural session.

national_news.title: NDA Governments in 21 States to Roll Out Uniform Civil Code Before 2029: HM Amit Shah
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced that BJP-led NDA governments across 21 states will implement the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) before 2029.
Under the new criminal justice framework of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, a system is being set up to deliver justice within three years, driving a 30% increase in conviction rates in key states.
Highlighted security achievements including the abrogation of Articles 370 and 35A, reduction of Naxalism, and the signing of over 14 peace agreements in the North-East region.

national_news.title: India Poutlines Key BRICS Initiatives at 18th Summit
bullets: India's BRICS Sherpa Sudhakar Dalela briefed media on key initiatives proposed during the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
Proposals included the BRICS Troika mechanism to ensure continuity between outgoing, current, and incoming chairs.
India pushed for a roadmap for reforming global governance structures and assistance measures for stranded seafarers and the Global South.

national_news.title: BRICS Summit Spotlights Dravidian Architecture at Bharat Mandapam
bullets: The 18th BRICS Summit hosted world leaders at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi against the backdrop of a grand corridor replicating the Rameswaram temple.
The architectural display featured the distinctive Dravidian architectural style of Tamil Nadu's Ramanathaswamy Temple.
Similar to the G20 Summit in 2023 which showcased Odisha's Konark Temple, India's multilateral presidencies are utilized to highlight regional heritage to global audiences.

national_news.title: Amit Shah Addresses 52nd India Gems & Jewellery Awards in Mumbai
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the 52nd India Gems and Jewellery Awards ceremony in Mumbai, emphasizing the rapid expansion of the lab-grown diamond sector.
Highlighted that the lab-grown diamond market volume is projected to grow nearly 50 times the size of the current diamond market.
Inaugurated a manuscript exhibition titled 'Shri Ganesh Dnyanarati' at the Asiatic Society of Mumbai to promote digital conservation of historical texts.

national_news.title: PM Modi Conducts Bilateral Meetings on Sidelines of BRICS Summit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi conducted 15 bilateral meetings with world leaders on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
Key engagements included discussions with leaders of Kazakhstan, Egypt, Indonesia, South Africa, Nigeria, and the Philippines.
The Philippines officially announced its decision to join the India-led Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI).

national_news.title: Prime Minister Chairs BRICS Session on Inclusive Global Governance in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the BRICS session on 'Inclusive Global Governance and Strengthening Multilateralism' during the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
PM Modi advocated transforming the 'pyramid of privilege into a platform of partnership' and proposed establishing a 'Seafarers Emergency Support Network'.
The session concluded with the adoption of the New Delhi BRICS Leaders' Declaration to guide future cooperation and reform in multilateral bodies like the UNSC.

national_news.title: Bairabi-Sairang Railway Lifeline Transforms Logistics and Connectivity in Mizoram
bullets: The Ministry of Railways celebrated the one-year milestone of the 51.38 km Bairabi-Sairang railway line connecting Mizoram's capital threshold to the national railway network.
The route features 55 major bridges, 88 minor bridges, 10 overbridges/underbridges, with its tallest bridge standing 42 meters taller than the Qutub Minar.
Key operational services include the Sairang-Anand Vihar Rajdhani Express, Sairang-Kolkata, Sairang-Guwahati, and Sairang-Silchar passenger trains.

national_news.title: Mizoram's Bairabi-Sairang Rail Line Completes One Year of Operations
bullets: Mizoram's 51.38-km Bairabi-Sairang rail line completed one year of operation, serving over 15 lakh passengers and transporting 2,500 freight wagons.
The engineering project includes 153 bridges (tallest rising up to 114 meters) and 45 tunnels spanning nearly 16 kilometres.
Direct train services to Delhi, Kolkata, and Guwahati have contributed to an 86% increase in Mizoram's tourism sector.

national_news.title: Amit Shah Urges Industry to Capture Entire Value Chain of Lab-Grown Diamonds
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the 52nd India Gems and Jewellery Awards in Mumbai, emphasizing self-reliance across the entire lab-grown diamond ecosystem.
Stated that the volume of the lab-grown diamond market is expected to expand nearly 50 times compared to the current diamond market size.
Inaugurated a manuscript exhibition titled 'Shri Ganesh Dnyanarati' at the Asiatic Society of Mumbai to encourage manuscript conservation via modern technology.

national_news.title: Ministry of Social Justice Expands Care Infrastructure and Assistive Living Support for Senior Citizens
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment reported that over 2.88 lakh senior citizens have received shelter, healthcare, physiotherapy, and essential support services.

To strengthen elderly care, 142 new Senior Citizen Homes were sanctioned, and 228 camps were organized to distribute around 23.93 lakh free assistive living devices (wheelchairs, hearing aids, spectacles) to over 4.91 lakh low-income beneficiaries.
The President of India launched the Senior Citizen's Welfare Portal as a unified platform for information dissemination regarding elderly welfare schemes and services.

national_news.title: Rashtriya Raksha University Hosts BRICS AML and CFT Capacity Building Programme
bullets: Rashtriya Raksha University (RRU), an Institution of National Importance, concluded a 5-day BRICS training programme on Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (CFT).

The programme focused on Financial Action Task Force (FATF) methodologies, beneficial ownership, and targeted financial sanctions in line with the Kazan Declaration 2024 and Rio de Janeiro Declaration 2025.
Delegates from BRICS nations and international dignitaries participated to enhance cross-border financial security, financial intelligence, and security research for the Global South.

national_news.title: BRICS Summit 2026 Adopts New Delhi Declaration Reaffirming Multilateral Reforms
bullets: The BRICS Summit 2026, hosted at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi, unanimously adopted the 'New Delhi Declaration' on its opening day, marking the 20th anniversary of the grouping.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi proposed a BRICS Continuity and Implementation Mechanism to maintain institutional momentum through the Troika, alongside a Seafarers Emergency Support Network for maritime assistance.
India outlined 10 global governance reform proposals to serve as a BRICS reform roadmap and called for time-bound UNSC reforms and equal participation of the Global South in technology governance.

national_news.title: RBI Reports Robust FCNR-B Inflows and Outlines Liquidity Management Strategy
bullets: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) reported robust inflows through Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) [FCNR-B] schemes, reflecting strong investor confidence in India's macro fundamentals.

The RBI noted that surplus liquidity in the banking system will be managed via currency in circulation, forex interventions, and reserve requirements to align the weighted average call rate with the repo rate.
The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) is evaluating inflation dynamics and crude oil price movements stemming from West Asian geopolitical tensions ahead of its policy meeting.

national_news.title: Second Season of Archery Premier League Scheduled in Hyderabad
bullets: The second season of the Archery Premier League (APL) will be hosted at People's Plaza in Hyderabad from October 8 to 18.
Jointly supported by the Archery Association of India and the Government of Telangana, the league features six mixed-gender franchise teams competing in Recurve and Compound categories.
The tournament incorporates a unique 15-second shot clock format, which is five seconds faster than standard Olympic timing to test speed and decision-making under pressure.

national_news.title: PM Modi Meets Global Leaders; UAE Announces $11.5 Billion Investment in Odisha
bullets: PM Narendra Modi held bilateral discussions with leaders of Ethiopia, Malaysia, Vietnam, and Abu Dhabi on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit 2026.
UAE's International Holding Company announced an $11.5 billion investment to establish an integrated greenfield aluminium project in Odisha.
Vietnam participated in the summit as a official Partner Country, reaffirming its strategic role as a major pillar in India's Act East Policy.

national_news.title: National Bamboo Mission Drives Livelihoods and Enterprise Growth
bullets: The National Bamboo Mission (NBM) continues to foster sustainable livelihoods, bamboo tissue culture, processing facilities, and market linkages for farmers and micro-enterprises across India.
A key regulatory reform in 2017 amended the Indian Forest Act 1927 to exclude bamboo grown in non-forest areas from the definition of a 'tree', deregulating its harvesting and transit.
Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and local enterprises across Northeastern states and Central India are leveraging platforms like the SARAS Aajeevika Mela to scale bamboo-based enterprises.

national_news.title: Mera Yuva Bharat Mobilizes Youth for Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue 2027
bullets: The 'Mera Yuva Bharat' (MY Bharat) initiative organized district-level advisory meetings to promote youth participation in the upcoming Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue (VBYLD) 2027.
The Viksit Bharat Quiz targets youth aged 15 to 29, featuring thematic tracks such as Design for Bharat, Youth Parliament, Hack for Social Cause, and Youth Entrepreneurs Challenge.
The initiative aims to align youth innovation, leadership skills, and talent with the vision of achieving Viksit Bharat @2047.

national_news.title: Saragarhi Day Commemorates the 1897 Historic Battle Martyrs
bullets: Saragarhi Day is commemorated on September 12 to honor 21 Sikh soldiers who defended the Saragarhi post against 10,000 Afghan tribesmen in 1897.
Led by Havaldar Ishar Singh of the 36th Sikh Regiment, the garrison fought to the last man in Samana village (present-day Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan).
The soldiers were posthumously awarded the Indian Order of Merit, the highest military bravery award available to Indian soldiers at the time, equivalent to today's Param Vir Chakra.

national_news.title: FCNR-B Inflows Reflect Strong Confidence in India's Macroeconomy: RBI
bullets: Inflows through Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) [FCNR-B] and related foreign capital schemes have remained robust, reflecting global confidence in India's macroeconomic stability.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) confirmed it has adequate monetary tools to manage surplus liquidity and align the weighted average call rate with the repo rate.
The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) is tracking West Asia crude oil price dynamics to assess their pass-through impact on domestic inflation and economic growth.

national_news.title: SEBI Proposes New Methodology for Expiry-Day Derivative Settlement Prices
bullets: Markets regulator SEBI issued a consultation paper proposing modified methodologies for calculating expiry-day settlement prices of index and stock derivatives.
The proposals evaluate a blended Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) using trades from the final 30 minutes of the Continuous Trading Session (CTS) and the 10-minute Closing Auction Session (CAS).
The revision aims to address feedback from market participants concerning the derivative settlement framework introduced in August.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / SSC CGL Indian Economy & Capital Markets

national_news.title: India's 2026 BRICS Presidency Broadens Strategic and Energy Ties with Gulf Nations
bullets: India's 2026 BRICS Presidency is expanding traditional energy relations with Gulf countries into food security, clean energy, storage logistics, and technology.
With Saudi Arabia and the UAE in the expanded BRICS, the grouping gains enhanced influence over global energy security and maritime trade through key conduits like the Strait of Hormuz.
India formally launched negotiations for a Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement with the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) covering Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / SSC CGL International Trade & Alliances

national_news.title: PIB Organizes First Media Exposure Tour from Arunachal Pradesh to Gujarat
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) concluded its first-ever exposure tour for media representatives from Arunachal Pradesh to Gujarat to foster national integration.

The delegation visited key infrastructure and developmental landmarks including Dholera Greenfield Smart City, GIFT City, Sabarmati Multimodal Transport Hub, AMUL, Sardar Sarovar Dam, and the Statue of Unity.
The program facilitated cultural exchange between North-Eastern and Western India, including interactions with the Rathwa tribal community in Ekta Nagar.

national_news.title: India Enters Women's Asia Cup 2026 Final after Defeating Bangladesh
bullets: India defeated Bangladesh by 40 runs in the first semi-final of the Women's Asia Cup 2026 held in Dubai to secure a spot in the tournament final.
Opener Shafali Verma was named Player of the Match for her top-scoring performance of 64 runs off 40 balls, leading India to 149/6.
Spinner Deepti Sharma took 3 wickets for India, restricting Bangladesh to 109/7 in their 20 overs.

national_news.title: Winners Felicitated at 27th National Youth Parliament Competition
bullets: Union Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Kiren Rijiju felicitated the winners of the 27th National Youth Parliament Competition (2025-26) for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNVs).
PM Shri Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Ukhrul-1, Manipur secured the top national position and received the Pt. Jawahar Lal Nehru Running Parliamentary Shield.

Organized by the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs for nearly 30 years, the competition saw participation from 100 Vidyalayas across eight regions to foster parliamentary practices and leadership skills.

national_news.title: Rubber Board Expands Natural Rubber Cultivation in Meghalaya
bullets: The Rubber Research Institute of India (RRII), under the Rubber Board, expanded rubber cultivation area in Meghalaya from 10,000 to approximately 33,000 hectares.
Institutional support is provided through a regional office at Tura, eight field stations, and Rubber Producers' Societies (RPS) across the Northeast.
Set up two Group Processing Centres (GPCs) under Green Hill RPS and Laurel Hills RPS in Mendipathar to process latex locally and improve farm-gate returns.

national_news.title: Union Home Minister Chairs 3rd NIDM Governing Body Meeting; Sets Zero-Casualty Vision
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired the 3rd Governing Body meeting of the National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM) in New Delhi, emphasizing a 'zero-casualty' vision and disaster-resilient infrastructure.
Highlighted a fourfold increase in State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) allocations and a threefold increase in National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) allocations.
Directed NDMA and NIDM to issue joint nationwide guidelines, track global climate risk research, and maintain permanent readiness for challenges like locust swarm attacks.

national_news.title: Centre Amends Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020 to Ban Dark Patterns and Fake Discounts
bullets: The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution amended the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020, coming into effect on January 1 next year.
Under new rules, discounted prices must disclose the 'prior price', defined strictly as the lowest price at which the product was offered during the preceding 30 days.
E-commerce entities are forbidden from manipulating search results or using dark patterns, and must mandate country-of-origin disclosures and integrate with the National Consumer Helpline.

national_news.title: India and Russia Pursue Joint Production of Civil Passenger Aircraft
bullets: India's Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu and Russia's Industry Minister Anton Alikhanov held discussions during the 'Innoprom India' event in New Delhi on joint manufacturing of civil commuter planes.
Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd. (HAL) and Russia's United Aircraft Corporation (UAC) previously inked an MoU for licensed joint production of the Superjet (SJ-100) in India.
Discussions included potential deliveries and arrangements for 105 regional turboprop aircraft to Indian regional airlines to bolster domestic air connectivity.

national_news.title: DRI Seizes Illegal Wildlife Products in Pan-India Anti-Trafficking Crackdown
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) conducted six intelligence-led operations across India, seizing leopard pelts, 180 live Indian Star Tortoises, 12 Tokay Geckos, 24 kg of pangolin scales, and tiger bones.
The Indian Star Tortoise (Geochelone elegans), leopard, and pangolin are protected under Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, while pangolins are also listed under Appendix I of CITES.
Seizures and apprehended individuals were handed over to respective State Forest Departments and identified in coordination with the Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB).
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / SSC / State PSC Environment & Ecology

national_news.title: Union Minister Manohar Lal Reviews Preparedness for Nationwide 'Swachhata Hi Seva 2026'
bullets: Union Minister for Housing and Urban Affairs Manohar Lal reviewed preparations with States/UTs for the 'Swachhata Hi Seva' (SHS) 2026 campaign, observing from September 17 to October 17.
The campaign theme is 'Swachhata Mein Sahbhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat', focusing on Cleanliness Target Units (CTUs), SafaiMitra welfare, and Waste-to-Wealth circular economy projects.
Key action points include a nationwide 'Shramdaan' drive on October 1 and special Urban Local Body council meetings on Swachh Bharat Diwas (October 2).

national_news.title: India Outlines Strategy for Women Entrepreneurship at BRICS WBA Forum
bullets: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal outlined three major hurdles for global trade entrants: credit access, market access, and predictable rules during the BRICS WBA Conference.
Revealed that out of 560 million small business loans extended in India, over 68% have been awarded to women entrepreneurs.
Targeted an increase in female workforce participation from 19% a decade ago to over 50%, aligning with developed economic benchmarks.

national_news.title: India to Work with BRICS Partners to Expand Opportunities for Women-Led Enterprises in Global Trade
bullets: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal addressed the BRICS WBA Women-Led Development Conference in New Delhi.
Goyal emphasized easing three key borders for women entrepreneurs: access to credit, access to buyers/markets, and predictable rules for free trade.
Highlighted India's financial inclusion metrics, including around 300 million bank accounts opened for women and collateral-free loans.
Noted the progress of 'Lakhpati Didis' where over 30 million rural women earn more than Rs 1 lakh in personal income through nearly 9 million self-help groups.

national_news.title: National Consumer Helpline Facilitates Refunds Exceeding Rs 105 Crore at Pre-Litigation Stage
bullets: The National Consumer Helpline (NCH) facilitated refunds of over Rs 105 crore across 35 sectors by resolving more than 1.66 lakh grievances between 25th April 2025 and 31st July 2026.
The e-commerce sector recorded the highest share with over one lakh complaints leading to refunds exceeding Rs 74 crore, followed by the Travel and Tourism sector with over Rs 10 crore.
Operated under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, NCH provides grievance redressal services in 17 languages using a convergence-based mechanism.

national_news.title: India Endorses Call to Action for 6G Leadership and Security
bullets: Union Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia announced India's endorsement of the Call to Action for 6G Leadership and Security.
The global partnership aims to shape 6G networks based on principles of openness, interoperability, security, and innovation-led competition.
India aims to secure 10 percent of global 6G standards ahead of the expected rollout in the 2030s.

national_news.title: India and Sri Lanka Sign MoUs on L70 Gun Upgradation and Defence Cooperation
bullets: India and Sri Lanka exchanged MoUs for upgrading L70 air defence guns for the Sri Lankan Air Force and fostering academic cooperation between defence institutions.
Defence Minister Rajnath Singh visited Colombo, where both sides reaffirmed their commitment to regional security, peace, and mutual developmental cooperation.
Both leaders virtually inaugurated three Bailey Bridges constructed by the Indian Defence Forces.

national_news.title: DRI Conducts Pan-India Crackdown Seizing 740 kg of Cannabis and Charas
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized approximately 740 kg of cannabis and charas in a nationwide crackdown over a fortnight.
A total of 13 individuals were arrested under the provisions of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.
Operations spanned road, rail, and air corridors, including major interceptions in Raipur, along the Aurangabad-Patna highway, Ludhiana, Gorakhpur, and international airports.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog National Workshop on Strengthening Ayush Ecosystem
bullets: Union Minister of State for Ayush Prataprao Jadhav urged States and UTs to enhance Ayush services nationwide at a workshop in Hyderabad.
The national workshop on 'Strengthening the Ayush Ecosystem' was organized by NITI Aayog at Kanha Shanti Vanam, Hyderabad.
Discussions focused on integrating Ayush with mainstream healthcare, quality improvement, accessibility, and technology-integrated evidence-based approaches.

national_news.title: Mizoram’s Saitual Becomes First District to Achieve ‘Surakshit’ HIV Status
bullets: Saitual district in Mizoram became the first in the state to attain 'Surakshit' status under the National AIDS Control Organisation's (NACO) Mobilisation AIDS Suraksha (MAS) campaign.
The district achieved all three UNAIDS-linked 95-95-95 HIV treatment and prevention targets regarding diagnosis, antiretroviral therapy (ART), and viral load suppression.
Under the MAS campaign, districts are categorized into Sangharshee, Saksham, Surakshit, and Surakshit+ based on their performance metrics.

national_news.title: 9th National Nutrition Month Inaugurated in Varanasi
bullets: The 9th National Nutrition Month was inaugurated at the International Rudraksh Convention Center in Varanasi by Uttar Pradesh CM Yogi Adityanath and Union Minister for Women and Child Development Annapurna Devi.
The campaign emphasizes pure and balanced nutrition linked to the health of mothers, children, and families under the vision prioritized since 2014.

Anganwadi centres in Uttar Pradesh are being transformed into holistic hubs for children's health, early development, and nutrition distribution under the 'Our Anganwadi, Our Responsibility' public participation campaign.

national_news.title: Nagaland Observes 9th Rashtriya Poshan Maah 2026 with Focus on Anganwadi Services
bullets: Nagaland is observing the month-long 9th Rashtriya Poshan Maah across the state under the theme 'Hamari Anganwadi, Hamari Jimmedari' (Our Anganwadi, Our Responsibility).

The campaign highlights five key priorities, including protein-rich dietary diversity, fresh meals at Anganwadi centres, early childhood stimulation, and marking the 10-year milestone of Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY).
It emphasizes the first 1,000 days of a child's life using learning tools like Navchetna and Aadharshila, alongside enrollment drives for Direct Benefit Transfers (DBT).

national_news.title: Indian Contingent Official Jersey Unveiled for Asian Games 2026 in Japan
bullets: Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya and IOA President P.T. Usha unveiled the official jersey for India's 503-member contingent participating in the Asian Games 2026 in Japan.
More than 300 athletes in the 503-member contingent are first-time participants at the Asian Games.
The Ministry reiterated a 10-year sports development plan with an allocation of over Rs 36,000 crore to build sports infrastructure aimed at hosting the 2036 Olympic Games.
national_news.exam_tag: SSC CGL / BPSC / Civil Services Exams

national_news.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Visits Sri Lanka to Bilateral Engagement
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh led a high-level delegation to Colombo, reiterating India's commitment to Sri Lanka based on shared history, civilisational ties, and strategic partnership.
Highlighted India's economic performance, noting a 7.8% GDP growth in Q1 of FY 2026-27 and a global growth contribution exceeding 16%.
Emphasized India's expanding trade diplomatic relations, having concluded trade deals with 38 countries and Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) with eight major nations, including the India-EU FTA.

national_news.title: PM-SETU Approves ₹735.70 Crore Investment Plans for ITI Clusters in Three States
bullets: The National Steering Committee under PM-SETU approved ₹735.70 crore for ITI clusters in Bhiwadi (Rajasthan), Medchal (Telangana), and Meerut (Uttar Pradesh), taking total scheme approvals to ₹2,171 crore across nine clusters.
Chaired by Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) Secretary Debashree Mukherjee, the scheme upgrades Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) using an industry-led hub model.
Rajasthan became the first state to execute a Shareholders' Agreement (SHA) under PM-SETU with MSDE and private partner H.G. Infra Engineering for cluster implementation.

national_news.title: International Literacy Day Celebrated Globally on 8th September
bullets: International Literacy Day is observed globally every year on September 8th, following its proclamation by UNESCO in 1966.
The theme for the celebration is 'Literacy for people, the planet and prosperity'.
UNESCO organized the main global conference in collaboration with the Government of Mexico, focusing on the Action Plan for the UNESCO Global Alliance for Literacy Strategy (2026–2029).

national_news.title: PM Modi Dedicated Western Dedicated Freight Corridor Sections and Projects Worth ₹35,000 Crore
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicated three key sections of the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (WDFC) in Vadodara, marking the operationalisation of the over 2,800 km Dedicated Freight Corridor network.

Inaugurated and laid foundation stones for projects worth over ₹35,000 crore, including ₹9,700 crore for railway expansion and ₹1,780 crore for National Highway projects across Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh.
Flagged off new freight services from New Sanand, New Makarpura, New Umbergaon, and New JNPT, alongside a new passenger train service connecting Tanda Road to Vadodara.

national_news.title: India joins 25-Nation Global Initiative for 6G Telecommunications
bullets: India has joined the United States and 24 other nations in an international initiative aimed at shaping technical standards, security, and innovation for next-generation 6G networks.
The announcement followed bilateral discussions between MoS Jitin Prasada and US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick during the G20 Innovation Ministerial in Chapel Hill, North Carolina.
Discussions highlighted enhanced collaboration in semiconductors under India Semiconductor Mission (ISM 2.0), AI safeguards, data centers, and Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI).

national_news.title: Government Keeps PSB Performance Linked Incentive Scheme in Abeyance
bullets: Union Minister of Finance met a delegation of Public Sector Bank (PSB) employees led by the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh to address key employee concerns.
The Ministry of Finance decided to keep the implementation of the Performance Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme (dated 19.11.2024) for FY 2025–26 in abeyance.
Issues regarding the PLI structure, review of ex-gratia, and medical facilities for retired bank employees will be addressed during ongoing Bipartite Settlement/Joint Note discussions.

national_news.title: India Participates in G20 Innovation Ministers' Meeting in Chapel Hill, US
bullets: Union Minister of State Jitin Prasada led the Indian delegation at the G20 Innovation Ministers' meeting held in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, hosted by the US Department of Commerce and the White House OSTP.

The ministers adopted the G20 Innovation Ministerial Statement and agreed on the 'Carolina Principles for Emerging Technologies', aimed at investing in foundational research, commercialisation, and trusted technology deployment.

Key deliverables included the AI Prosperity Objectives and AI Prosperity Compact, while India offered its 'India Stack' Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) solutions to African nations during bilateral side-talks.

national_news.title: Union Finance Minister Meets Bank Employees Delegation; PLI Scheme Kept in Abeyance
bullets: Union Finance Minister met with a delegation of bank employees from Public Sector Banks (PSBs) led by the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh.
The Performance Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme dated 19.11.2024 for FY 2025-26 has been kept in abeyance in response to employees' concerns.
Other issues raised include a review of ex-gratia, medical facilities for retired employees, and structured discussions under Bipartite Settlement/Joint Note.

national_news.title: Sheetal Devi Reaches Final at World Archery Para Series Stage 3
bullets: World champion Sheetal Devi secured a medal for India by advancing to the women's compound individual final at the World Archery Para Series in Ahmedabad.
She defeated fellow Indian archer Sarita 145-143 in the semifinals to set up a gold medal clash with Kazakhstan's Aizada Seidan.
The tournament features archers across compound and W1 categories, where W1 refers to athletes with impairments in at least three limbs.

national_news.title: Government Enhances DBT & Aadhaar Delivery for SC Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment reviewed the implementation of the Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste (SC) students.

Fund disbursement relies on Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), introduced in 2021-22, and mandatory Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) to ensure transparent beneficiary targeting and de-duplication.
The Central government share is released strictly upon the disbursement of the corresponding State/UT share and verification of beneficiary data on the central portal.
national_news.exam_tag: Social Welfare Schemes & Direct Benefit Transfer

national_news.title: PM Inaugurates Key WDFC Sections and Global Fintech Fest 2026
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicated three key sections (326 route km worth over ₹20,700 crore) of the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (WDFC) to the nation in Vadodara, marking the full operationalization of the DFC network.

Laid the foundation stone for railway and national highway projects worth over ₹35,000 crore, including direct rail connectivity to Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA) to streamline EXIM cargo movements.
Inaugurated the Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2026 in Mumbai centered on the theme: 'Potential to Impact: Agentic AI, Tokenisation, Quantum - Trusted, Connected, Global Systems for Inclusive Finance'.

national_news.title: 11th Ayurveda Day 2026 Launched as a National Health Campaign
bullets: Union Minister of State for Health & Family Welfare Prataprao Jadhav announced the campaign for the 11th Ayurveda Day at the National Media Centre, New Delhi.
The campaign focuses on three core pillars: Integrative Healthcare for Better Health Outcomes, Evidence/Research/Innovation in Ayurveda, and Ayurveda for Community Wellbeing and Sustainable Living.

Key highlights include the presentation of the National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Awards 2026 and initiatives by the National Institute of Ayurveda (NIA), Jaipur, including safety dossiers on medicinal plants and treatment guidelines for skin diseases.

national_news.title: DAC Clears Defence Acquisition Proposals Worth ₹1.10 Lakh Crore
bullets: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh, accorded Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) for capital acquisition proposals worth approximately ₹1,10,000 crore.

Key approvals include CBRN Recce Vehicles, High Mobility Vehicles, and Sarvatra Bridge System for the Army; Arudhra Radars and indigenous Marine Gas Turbines for the Navy; and Ground-Based Multi-Purpose Jammers and RFID-based DEFSAC smart cards for the Air Force.
In alignment with the 'Make in India' initiative, approximately 98% of the total procurement amount is targeted to be sourced from the domestic Indian industry.

national_news.title: Union Environment Minister Engages 63 NCR Urban Bodies for 'Clean Air Mission'
bullets: Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav led a dialogue with Mayors and local representatives from 63 National Capital Region (NCR) cities to tackle air pollution.
Emphasized strict grassroots enforcement of Solid Waste Management Rules and Construction & Demolition (C&D) Waste Management Rules by urban local bodies.
Highlighted the role of the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) as a centralized institutional mechanism for technical support and air quality enforcement in the NCR.

national_news.title: India and Luxembourg Strengthen Strategic Partnership Across Key Sectors
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met Luxembourg's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Xavier Bettel in New Delhi to review bilateral ties.
Key discussion areas included financial cooperation, trade, investment, space technology, digital infrastructure, green technologies, and healthcare.
Luxembourg reaffirmed its strong support for the swift conclusion and ratification of the India-European Union Free Trade Agreement (FTA).

national_news.title: ISRO Clarifies Space Sector Reforms Focus on Ecosystem Expansion, Not Privatization
bullets: ISRO clarified that recent space sector reforms aim to build a larger, globally competitive ecosystem rather than privatize the agency or diminish its role.
Private sector participation will allow industry to scale mature technologies and commercialization, expanding India's global market presence.
The division of operational tasks allows ISRO's scientific workforce to focus on high-end research, next-generation technologies, and complex national space missions.

national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Growing India-France Strategic and Cultural Ties at Paris Temple Inauguration
bullets: PM Narendra Modi virtually addressed the inauguration of the BAPS Swaminarayan Hindu Mandir in Paris, describing the partnership as 'Made in India and Built in France'.
Both nations are celebrating the ongoing year as the 'India-France Year of Innovation', focusing on AI, defense, space, technology, and climate action.
The Prime Minister emphasized historical and spiritual connections, noting the contributions of French scholars to Sanskrit and spiritual links through ISKCON and Aurobindo Ashram.

national_news.title: Vice President Addresses Golden Jubilee of Geetanagar College in Assam
bullets: Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan addressed the Golden Jubilee celebrations of Geetanagar College in Guwahati, emphasizing youth empowerment and anti-drug advocacy.
Highlighted Assam's economic growth, noting a 45% expansion in the state economy over the past five years and a 54% increase in per capita income between 2021-22 and 2024-25.
Reiterated the goal of Viksit Bharat by 2047, stressing that inclusive development in the North East is essential for national progress.

national_news.title: Indore Metro Priority Corridor-2 Inaugurated, Network Expands to 17 Km
bullets: Union Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal and MP Chief Minister Mohan Yadav inaugurated the 11-km Priority Corridor-2 (Reach-II) of the Indore Metro.
Developed at an estimated cost of Rs 2,850 crore, the new stretch extends from Super Corridor-3 to Malviya Nagar Chauraha across 11 stations.
With this expansion, Indore Metro's operational network covers approximately 17 km with 16 stations, bringing the total cumulative project cost to Rs 4,370 crore.

national_news.title: 16th National Meet of State Biodiversity Boards Held in Chandigarh
bullets: The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) organized the 16th National Meet of State Biodiversity Boards (SBBs) and UT Biodiversity Councils (UTBCs) in Chandigarh from September 6–7, 2026.

Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav urged states and UTs to align local governance mechanisms with the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023 and Biological Diversity Rules, 2024.

The meet highlighted the role of Biodiversity Management Committees (BMCs) and People's Biodiversity Registers (PBRs), alongside India's progress on international commitments including the 7th National Report to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD).

national_news.title: IAF Sarang Helicopter Display Team Participates in Egypt's El Alamein Airshow
bullets: The Indian Air Force's Sarang Helicopter Display Team is participating in the second edition of the El Alamein International Airshow at El Alamein International Airport, Egypt.
Operating the indigenously designed Advanced Light Helicopter (ALH) Dhruv, the five-helicopter display team will debut a new manoeuvre called 'Spot Stall Turn' alongside its 'Dolphin Leap'.
Formed in 2002, the Sarang team represents IAF's international defense diplomacy and showcases indigenous aerospace capabilities.

national_news.title: PM Addresses Centenary Celebrations of Shri Ram College of Commerce in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the centenary celebrations of Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC) in New Delhi.
He highlighted India's 7.8 percent quarterly economic growth rate amid global uncertainty, attributing it to a shift from policy paralysis to policy dynamism.
The event highlighted India's emergence as the world's third-largest startup ecosystem and the goal of achieving Viksit and Aatmanirbhar Bharat.

national_news.title: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh Launches 'CSS Shield' Initiative
bullets: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh launched the 'CSS Shield' initiative set up by the Central Secretariat Service (CSS) Forum in New Delhi.
The mechanism serves as a mutual financial support system aimed at providing a minimum assistance of Rs 15 lakh to the families of deceased CSS officers.
Since 2020, CSS officers have voluntarily contributed around Rs 1.30 crore to assist families of approximately 65 to 70 deceased colleagues.

national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with 82 National Teachers' Day Award Winners
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with 82 National Teachers' Award winners across school education, higher education, and skill development sectors.
He urged teachers to look beyond textbooks, emphasize experiential learning, and connect students with real-world practical skills under NEP guidance.
The PM raised concerns regarding excessive screen time among children and called for continuous awareness campaigns against drug abuse.

national_news.title: CSS Forum Launches 'CSS Shield' Mutual Financial Support Initiative for Families of Deceased Officers
bullets: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh launched the 'CSS Shield' initiative organized by the Central Secretariat Service (CSS) Forum in New Delhi.
The initiative establishes a structured mutual financial support mechanism aimed at providing at least Rs 15 lakh in financial assistance to the families of deceased CSS officers.
Since 2020, voluntary contributions by CSS officers have raised nearly Rs 1.30 crore to support 65–70 bereaved families of officers lost during and after the COVID-19 period.

national_news.title: UNGA Adopts Resolution to Standardize 'Equal Earth' Map Projection over Mercator Map
bullets: The UN General Assembly adopted the non-binding 'Correct the Map' resolution sponsored by Togo and supported by 164 nations, including India, France, and the UK.
The resolution advocates replacing the traditional 1569 Mercator map projection with the 2018 'Equal Earth projection' to accurately reflect the true relative sizes of continents.
The 16th-century Mercator map distorts landmasses near the poles, visually shrinking equatorial regions and depicting Africa as similar in size to Greenland despite being 14 times larger.

national_news.title: UN General Assembly Adopts Resolution to Correct African Continent Size on Maps
bullets: The UN General Assembly voted to adopt the 'Correct the Map' resolution, sponsored by Togo and backed by the African Union, replacing the traditional Mercator map.
The traditional 16th-century Mercator map distorts landmasses, showing Africa similar in size to Greenland despite being 14 times larger.
The non-binding resolution encourages institutions to adopt representations like the Equal Earth projection for accurate geographical proportions.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Confers National Teachers' Awards 2024
bullets: Teachers' Day is observed annually on September 5th to mark the birth anniversary of former President Dr Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.
President Droupadi Murmu conferred National Awards on 48 school teachers from 27 States, 7 UTs, and 6 Central Government organizations in New Delhi.
National Awards were also presented to 21 teachers and faculty members from higher education institutions and polytechnics.

national_news.title: Inaugural Drass District Festival Organized in Ladakh for Eco-Tourism
bullets: The first-ever two-day Drass District Festival was inaugurated in Ladakh by Deputy Commissioner Kacho Imtiyaz Ahmed to boost cultural and eco-tourism.
A special Nature Trail was organized across the Drass and Mushkoh valleys to raise awareness about the fragile local ecosystem and the conservation of the endangered Himalayan Brown Bear.
The festival integrated traditional sports like Horse Polo alongside cultural displays to encourage sustainable tourism and local artisan livelihoods.

national_news.title: Meghalaya Hosts 5th Sohra International Half Marathon 2026
bullets: The 5th Sohra International Half Marathon was organized by the Meghalaya State Olympics Association (MSOA) and the Directorate of Sports and Youth Affairs, drawing 11,672 participants.
Satish Kumar Verma won the Elite Men’s 21 km category in 1:03:04, while Tejaswini Narendra Lambkane secured the Elite Women’s title in 1:15:20.
The event, recognized by the Athletics Federation of India (AFI), aimed to position Meghalaya as a major sports and eco-tourism hub.

national_news.title: MEA Briefs on Nepal Flood Rescue, Ukraine Diplomatic Visit, and Malé Connectivity Project
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) confirmed that 166 Indian nationals have been rescued in flood-ravaged Nepal, with plans to deploy Bailey bridges and forensic kits.
EAM Dr. S. Jaishankar visited Kyiv, Ukraine, meeting President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to reiterate India's position favoring diplomacy and dialogue over conflict.
MEA announced the successful completion of the first segment of the India-backed Greater Malé Connectivity Project in the Maldives.

national_news.title: NAMASTE Cards Distributed to Waste Pickers Under Central Sanitation Scheme
bullets: Union Minister of State for Social Justice and Empowerment inaugurated the issuance of National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) Cards and Ayushman Cards to waste pickers.
NAMASTE is a Central Sector Scheme implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment to ensure safety, formal recognition, and socio-economic upliftment of sanitation workers.
The initiative aims to eliminate hazardous manual cleaning through mechanisation, skill development, and providing social security and healthcare benefits.

national_news.title: CSIR-IIIM Showcases Biotech and Aroma Initiatives at Kathua Industrial Biotech Park
bullets: A press delegation visited the Industrial Biotech Park (IBTP) in Kathua, J&K, coordinated by PIB to review biotechnology and agricultural initiatives executed by CSIR-IIIM Jammu.

The IBTP Kathua hosts the BioNEST Bioincubation Centre and Centre of Excellence (CoE) to provide scientific facilities, mentorship, and testing infrastructure to tech startups in biotechnology, health, and agriculture.
Key initiatives highlighted include the CSIR Aroma Mission and Floriculture Mission, which connect laboratory scientific research directly with farmers cultivating medicinal and aromatic plants.

national_news.title: India to Appoint Defence Attaché to Brussels During Belgian PM's Visit
bullets: India announced the appointment of a Defence Attaché to Brussels, complementing Belgium's placement of a Defence Attaché in New Delhi earlier in the year.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever set a target to double bilateral trade from the current 13 billion USD over the next five years.
Key discussions focused on 'Trade, Technology, and Talent' (3 Ts), with PM Modi inviting Belgian academic institutions to establish campuses in India and participate in WAVES 2.0.

national_news.title: Commerce Ministry Launches Nationwide Drive to Boost Free Trade Agreement Utilisation
bullets: Union Minister Piyush Goyal addressed the National Workshop on 'Leveraging FTAs: An Outreach Programme' in New Delhi, urging an outreach campaign across all 780 districts to expand MSME and exporter participation.
India currently operates nine Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) covering economies with a combined GDP of around $60 trillion, giving preferential market access to nearly two-thirds of global trade.
India's exports reached approximately $317 billion during the April-July period (up $36-37 billion year-on-year), supporting the broader objective of becoming a $30 trillion economy by 2047.

national_news.title: EAM S. Jaishankar Visits Ukraine, Reaffirms Support for Peaceful Resolution
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy during a three-day visit to Ukraine and Poland.
India stressed the impact of ongoing commercial shipping attacks on Global South supply chains, notably fuel, fertilizer, and food shortages.
India has dispatched 19 consignments of humanitarian aid totaling 160 tonnes to Ukraine, including generator sets, medicines, and medical equipment.

national_news.title: India and Belgium Launch Strategic Dialogue and Sign Key Security Agreements
bullets: India and Belgium launched the India-Belgium Strategic Dialogue and signed a Letter of Intent to strengthen defence manufacturing, regular exchanges, and research.
An MoU was executed between India's Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and the Federal Police of Belgium to combat cybercrime and transnational crime.
Belgium reaffirmed its support for India's permanent membership bid in a reformed United Nations Security Council (UNSC).

national_news.title: Ukraine Welcomes India's Peace Diplomacy During First Dedicated EAM Visit
bullets: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha welcomed EAM S Jaishankar on the first dedicated bilateral visit by an Indian External Affairs Minister to Ukraine.
Both leaders discussed key global issues, including the restoration of freedom of navigation in the Black Sea and global food security.
Bilateral talks covered expanding partnerships across infrastructure, pharmaceuticals, technological innovation, and digitalization.
