national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Visits Kyiv to Discuss Peace Initiatives and Bilateral Cooperation
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S Jaishankar visited Kyiv, meeting Ukrainian FM Andrii Sybiha and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to offer support for ending the conflict through diplomacy.
India highlighted that it has dispatched 19 consignments of humanitarian assistance weighing 160 tonnes to Ukraine, including medical supplies and generator sets.
Jaishankar stressed the impact of attacks on commercial shipping in the Global South, emphasizing the need to secure food, fuel, and fertilizer supply chains.

national_news.title: 18th BRICS Intellectual Property Heads Meeting Held in New Delhi
bullets: The 18th Meeting of the Heads of IP Offices of BRICS Countries was hosted in New Delhi by the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM) under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
Aligned with India's BRICS Chairship theme, 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability', the meeting adopted Updated Operational Guidelines to align global IP standards.
Delegates agreed on protection frameworks for traditional knowledge systems, patent analytics for Geographical Indications (GIs), and establishing the IP BRICS FinTech Innovation Monitor.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Unveils 'RAKSHA' Strategic Framework for Defence Diplomacy
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched 'RAKSHA', a comprehensive defence diplomacy document setting out India's strategic 10-year roadmap for global defence partnerships.
The blueprint focuses on four key pillars: strategic partnerships, military capacity building, indigenous defence exports under 'Make-in-India', and maritime security.
The policy reinforces India's operational role as a Net Security Provider and First Responder in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR) to foster long-term global stability.

national_news.title: India and Belgium Agree to Deepen Defence Cooperation and Maritime Security Ties
bullets: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh held bilateral talks with Belgium's Defence and Foreign Trade Minister Theo Francken in New Delhi to review defence and industrial collaboration.
Both nations agreed to expand ties through defence cooperation dialogues, joint military training, capacity building, and enhanced maritime security collaboration in the Indo-Pacific region.
The defence meeting was held alongside high-level bilateral discussions between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever.

national_news.title: NHPC Prepared to Begin Execution of 1,856 MW Sawalkot Hydropower Project in J&K
bullets: NHPC is set to execute the 1,856 MW Sawalkot Hydroelectric Project in Ramban district, Jammu & Kashmir, pending final clearances from the Public Investment Board (PIB) and the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA).

Located in the Chenab basin, the project is a major component of India's strategic push to maximize the utilization of Western Rivers (Indus, Jhelum, Chenab) under the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty framework.
The infrastructure project spans Ramban, Udhampur, and Reasi districts, requiring 1,401.35 hectares of land, with Ramban accounting for nearly 89% of the total submergence area.

national_news.title: Japan Credit Rating Agency upgrades India's sovereign credit rating to 'A-' with Stable Outlook
bullets: Japan Credit Rating Agency (JCR) upgraded India’s Long-Term Foreign Currency and Local Currency Issuer Ratings from 'BBB+' to 'A-' with a Stable Outlook.
The upgrade reflects India's solid economic growth, effective policy implementation, improved fiscal quality, and enhanced soundness of the financial system.
JCR noted the Central Government's fiscal deficit declined from 4.7 percent in FY25 to 4.4 percent in FY26 while maintaining high capital expenditure.

national_news.title: Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever Begins Official Visit to India
bullets: Prime Minister of Belgium Bart De Wever initiated a three-day official visit to India, marking the first visit by a Belgian Prime Minister in two decades.
Bilateral talks focus on strengthening cooperation across trade, defense ecosystems, renewable energy, and advancing the India-EU Free Trade Agreement.
Bilateral trade between India and Belgium exceeded $13 billion in 2025-26, heavily anchored by the global diamond trade connecting Antwerp and Mumbai.

national_news.title: Retd Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra Appointed as First CEO of Shri Ram Janmbhoomi Kshetra Trust
bullets: Former Commander of Western Air Command, Retired Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra, was appointed as the first CEO of Shri Ram Janmbhoomi Kshetra Trust in Ayodhya.
The selection was made by a three-member search committee headed by retired Justice Pramod Kohli to oversee administrative and operational functions of the temple complex.
Mishra played a key role in Operation Sindoor and is a recipient of the Ati Vishisht Seva Medal and Vishisht Seva Medal.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses Valedictory Session of National Departmental Summit on Water
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the valedictory session of the two-day National Departmental Summit on Water, organized by the Ministry of Jal Shakti.
Called for sensitizing Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) to urbanization challenges and water demands by organizing dedicated 'Chintan Shivirs'.
Emphasized 'Jan Bhagidari' through 'Jal Utsav', standard operating procedures (SOPs) for de-silting, dam safety awareness, and leveraging AI for water data governance.

national_news.title: Gujarat Media Delegation Visits CSIR-IIIM Jammu
bullets: A media delegation from Gujarat visited the CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine (CSIR-IIIM) in Jammu under a PIB-coordinated tour.
Director Dr Zabeer Ahmed highlighted the institute's work in drug discovery, medicinal plants, and the Aroma Mission leading to the Purple Revolution.
The delegation explored research facilities, the BioNEST Incubator, and startup support ecosystems.

national_news.title: Districts as Export Hubs (DEH) Initiative: Expanding India's Grassroots Exports
bullets: The Districts as Export Hubs (DEH) initiative transforms every district into a center of export planning by identifying local products and services with global potential.
Building upon the One District One Product (ODOP) concept, the DEH initiative covers more than 770 districts across India as of January 2026.
India's total exports of goods and services reached an estimated US$ 863.11 billion in 2025-26, driven by convergence frameworks under the Department of Commerce and DGFT.

national_news.title: India Post Payments Bank Launches Digital Mutual Fund and Insurance Platforms
bullets: India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) launched digital platforms for mutual funds and insurance on its 9th Foundation Day.
The platforms provide customers access to mutual fund investments alongside life, health, and general insurance solutions.
As of March 2026, IPPB boasts 13.25 crore customers, with 77% located in rural areas, leveraging the massive network of nearly 1.65 lakh post offices.

national_news.title: Ministry of Statistics Releases Updated GDP Series and Double Deflation Methodology Details
bullets: The Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) released updated annual and quarterly GDP estimates with the base year 2022-23.
The updated series incorporates the Output Producer Price Index (PPI), Banking Services Price Index (BkSPI), and the double-deflation methodology.
MoSPI clarified that a negative implicit GVA deflator in sectors like manufacturing does not imply falling prices, but rather reflects input prices rising faster than output prices.

national_news.title: INS Sudarshini Arrives in Barcelona for Lokayan 2026
bullets: Indian Navy's sail training ship INS Sudarshini arrived in Barcelona, Spain, as part of its ongoing transoceanic expedition, Lokayan 26.
The 10-month expedition commenced in January 2026, serving as a flagship voyage to showcase India's maritime traditions and naval excellence.
During the port call, the ship undertook professional interactions, seamanship exchanges, and cultural engagements with the Spanish Navy and local maritime stakeholders.

national_news.title: Indian Forensic Team Assists in DNA Analysis for Flash Flood Victims in Nepal
bullets: A 19-member Indian forensic team began DNA analysis to help identify victims of recent flash floods in Nepal.
The analysis is being conducted at the Nepal Police Central Forensic Science Laboratory and the National Forensic Science Laboratory in Kathmandu.
The initiative supports Nepal in processing DNA samples from unclaimed bodies as the death toll and number of missing persons continue to rise.

national_news.title: Government Reduces Sugar Stock Limit to 2,000 Quintals to Ensure Price Stability
bullets: The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution reduced the stock holding limit for sugar dealers from 4,000 quintals to 2,000 quintals.
The new limit is effective from the 15th of the month until November 30th to curb hoarding, speculative trading, and ensure price stability.
Sugar dealers cannot hold stock exceeding 30 days from the date of receipt, while Kolkata and its extended metropolitan areas retain the 4,000 quintal limit.

national_news.title: Indian Men's T20I Squad Announced for Series Against Afghanistan
bullets: BCCI announced a 15-member Indian men's squad led by captain Shreyas Iyer and vice-captain Tilak Varma for a three-match T20I series against Afghanistan in New Delhi.
Fast bowler Jasprit Bumrah makes his return to the national team alongside Nitish Kumar Reddy, Washington Sundar, and Harshit Rana.
The selected squad largely reflects India's team composition for the upcoming Asian Games set to take place in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.

national_news.title: Civil Aviation Ministry Launches Hub & Spoke Operations at Ahmedabad Airport
bullets: Union Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu launched Hub & Spoke international flight operations at Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport in Ahmedabad.
Ahmedabad becomes the third airport in India to join the Hub & Spoke framework for seamless international passenger transit, following Varanasi and Amritsar, with plans to expand to 22 more airports.
The initiative falls under the government's International Aviation Hub Strategy, which aims to make India a preferred aviation hub by 2030 and a leading global hub by 2047.

national_news.title: Union Agriculture Minister Reviews Progress of PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana
bullets: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan reviewed the progress of PM-DDKY, targeting holistic agricultural improvement across 100 selected districts.
The scheme operates through the convergence of 36 Central schemes across 11 Ministries and Departments, monitored using 121 key output and outcome indicators.
Approved by the Union Cabinet and launched on October 11, 2025, the program's average performance score across the designated districts rose from 22.54 in April 2026 to 38.85 in July 2026.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Invokes Article 142 to Quash Nationwide FIRs Against Protesting Students
bullets: A Supreme Court bench led by CJI Surya Kant invoked special powers under Article 142 of the Constitution to quash and close FIRs registered across states against students protesting the NEET paper leak.
The directive applies to protest incidents that occurred between July 20 and July 25, barring states and Union Territories from registering any fresh FIRs related to these events.

The court recorded the Solicitor General's statement that a central policy to provide financial compensation to families of students who died by suicide post-NEET cancellation will be formulated within three months.

national_news.title: India Participates in G20 FMCBG Meeting in Asheville, US
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman led the Indian delegation at the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors (FMCBG) meeting held in Asheville, US.
Discussions centered on global economic stability, managing sovereign debt, reforming international financial institutions, and promoting sustainable trade.
The host country highlighted that the main G20 Leaders' Summit is scheduled to be held in Miami on December 14-15.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Outlines Risk-Based Customs and Banking Reforms to Sustain Economic Growth
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced proposed customs reforms, including scanner deployment and risk-based automatic import clearances to ease port congestion.
India's foreign exchange reserves reached approximately USD 700 billion, alongside a recorded economic growth rate of 7.8 per cent in Q1.
The government is preparing a high-level review of the banking sector's role to drive the next phase of structural economic reforms.

national_news.title: India Rejects Hague Court of Arbitration Ruling on Indus Waters Treaty
bullets: India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) rejected a ruling by the World Bank-constituted Court of Arbitration in The Hague, declaring the tribunal's decisions legally invalid and lacking jurisdiction.
India reiterated that it did not participate in the arbitration proceedings and maintained that the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty remains in abeyance due to national security concerns.

The ruling called on India to continue observing its obligations under the 1960 treaty, which India rejected on grounds that the arbitration panel itself was established in violation of treaty provisions.

national_news.title: IIT Jammu and NHAI Showcase Key Indigenous Tech and Infrastructure Projects
bullets: IIT Jammu highlighted indigenous innovations including 'Litter Vision', an AI and IoT-enabled system utilizing UAV surveillance to manage plastic waste along fragile Himalayan corridors like the Amarnath Yatra route.
Researchers at IIT Jammu's IC-ResQ Lab demonstrated the indigenous 'iPACE-CHIP' pacemaker chip being developed under the central Chips to Start-up (C2S) Programme.

NHAI reported progress on the Kathua-Katra section of the Delhi-Amritsar-Katra Expressway targeting completion by November 2027, alongside plans for a parallel tube at the Syama Prasad Mookerjee Chenani-Nashri Tunnel.

national_news.title: 11th Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit to be Held in Gandhinagar
bullets: The 11th Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit will take place from 10th to 12th January in Gandhinagar under the theme 'Viksit Gujarat – Shaping Global Future'.
First conceptualised in 2003, the biennial summit has evolved into a global platform for business networking, strategic partnerships, and investments.
The upcoming summit focuses on green hydrogen, green energy, semiconductors, technology, agriculture, and food processing sectors.

national_news.title: Government Notifies Semicon 2.0 Scheme with Rs 1.27 Lakh Crore Outlay
bullets: Union Minister for Electronics and Information Technology Ashwini Vaishnaw notified the Semicon 2.0 scheme with an outlay of Rs 1.27 lakh crore across six pillars.
The program aims to embed India deeply into the global semiconductor value chain, spanning from wafer fabrication to end-to-end chip production.
India projects capturing nearly 10% of the global semiconductor market share through sustained policy support, talent development, and ecosystem expansion.

national_news.title: President Addresses Convocation of National Institute of Fashion Technology
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the convocation ceremony of the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT), highlighting the textile sector's critical role in preserving cultural heritage and generating employment.
Emphasized significant female representation in the fashion and design sector, noting that women accounted for nearly 85% of the graduating students.
Urged students to connect India's traditional craft heritage with global contemporary markets to contribute towards the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047.

national_news.title: DoT and Himachal Pradesh Partner to Accelerate National Broadband Mission 2.0
bullets: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) partnered with the Himachal Pradesh government to speed up implementation of National Broadband Mission (NBM) 2.0 and Digital Bharat Nidhi (DBN)-funded projects.
NBM 2.0 focuses on extending Optical Fibre Cable (OFC) network and high-speed broadband to rural, hilly, border, and unserved areas.
The mission aims to ensure last-mile digital connectivity to primary health centers, schools, Anganwadi centers, and Gram Panchayat offices.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Visits Bishkek for 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, on a two-day visit to attend the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit.
The theme of the summit is '25 Years of the SCO: Together Towards Sustainable Peace, Development and Prosperity', focusing on counter-terrorism and regional stability.
Key engagements include bilateral talks with leaders of Armenia, Kyrgyzstan, Iran, and Russia, alongside attending the 6th World Nomad Games.

national_news.title: Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026 Notified by Consumer Affairs Department
bullets: The Department of Consumer Affairs notified the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026, establishing Indian Standard Time (IST) as the unified reference for legal, administrative, commercial, and digital purposes across India, effective 180 days post-gazette notification.

The rules encourage critical sectors—such as banking, telecommunications, railways, and power systems—to adopt NavIC (India's satellite navigation system) and approved domestic timing sources to reduce reliance on foreign satellite time.

As part of the 'One Nation, One Time' initiative, a White Rabbit Technology-based IST Dissemination Demonstration Network was commissioned at RRSL Bengaluru in July 2026 in collaboration with CSIR-NPL, ISRO, SEBI, NSE, and BSNL.

national_news.title: PM Highlights Women Empowerment via PM SVANidhi and Mission ShaktiSAT
bullets: Women account for approximately 46% (around 35 lakh) of total beneficiaries expanding businesses under the PM SVANidhi scheme.
The second phase of 'Mission ShaktiSAT' was launched at Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida, offering satellite technology training to 12,000 female students across 108 countries.
PM Modi reiterated focus on the nationwide 'Nasha-mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat' campaign targeting a drug-free youth movement.

national_news.title: India and Uzbekistan Elevate Relations to Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev agreed to elevate bilateral ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in Tashkent.
Key outcomes include establishing a long-term uranium supply deal, three sister-city/sister-state arrangements, and elevating the Joint Commission to Ministerial level.
Both nations established a Coordination Council at the Foreign Minister level to oversee bilateral cooperation.

national_news.title: FSSAI Issues Prohibition Order on Compounded Hing of Major Brands for Substandard Quality
bullets: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, issued a Prohibition of Sale order for Compounded Hing from Everest Food Products and LG Brand Unit.
Laboratory testing revealed tested Compounded Hing contained only 0–3% alcohol soluble extract, falling short of the mandatory 5% minimum required under FSS Regulations, 2011.
Raw Hing samples collected from LG Brand Unit contained 15% to 32% starch content, significantly violating the statutory ceiling limit of 1%.

national_news.title: Ministry of Education Highlights A Decade of Progress in Higher Education Sector
bullets: Data from the All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) shows universities in India grew by 69.6% from 760 in 2014–15 to 1,289 in 2023–24, while colleges increased by 25.3% to 48,246.

Total higher education student enrolment rose by 31.5% to reach 4.50 crore in 2023–24, pushing the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) to 30% against the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 target of 50% by 2035.
Female student enrolment grew by 42.2% over the decade, rising from 1.57 crore in 2014–15 to 2.24 crore in 2023–24.

national_news.title: National Sports Day 2026 Observed Across India on August 29
bullets: National Sports Day is celebrated annually on August 29 to mark the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.
The 2026 nationwide campaign was conducted under the call 'Ek Ghanta Khel Ke Maidan Mein', focused on three pillars: Tribute, Play, and Move.
Budgetary allocation for the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports reached over ₹4,400 crore in Union Budget 2026-27, boosting schemes like Khelo India, TOPS, and KIRTI.

national_news.title: India Dispatches Emergency Humanitarian Aid and Rescue Teams to Nepal
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) coordinated the rescue of 108 Indian nationals following devastating flash floods in Nepal.
India dispatched a C-130J Hercules aircraft carrying 11 tonnes of assistance, an Indian Army tunnel rescue team, and forensic teams for sample analysis.
India has provided 68.5 tonnes of emergency relief material and sent equipment to install eight modular steel and Bailey bridges to restore connectivity.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Holds Bilateral Talks with Uzbek President in Tashkent
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev in Tashkent to strengthen multi-sectoral cooperation.
Key discussion areas included defence, digital connectivity, energy, medicine, agriculture, and mining of rare earth minerals and gold.
Bilateral trade between India and Uzbekistan has grown by 300% over the past decade, with both nations targeting to double the current $1 billion trade.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Highlights India's Investment Potential at Chicago Roundtable
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed a high-level Business Roundtable in Chicago, organized by the Consulate General of India and the US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF).

Highlighted India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)—including Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, ONDC, and India Stack—and emphasized the evolution of Global Capability Centres into global innovation hubs.
Promoted manufacturing opportunities under Atmanirbhar Bharat, iDEX, and Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes while pitching GIFT IFSC as an international financial hub.

national_news.title: India and Argentina Hold 4th Joint Trade Committee Meeting to Expand Bilateral Ties
bullets: The 4th India-Argentina Joint Trade Committee (JTC) meeting was held in Buenos Aires, co-chaired by Indian Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal and Argentina's Secretary for International Economic Relations Fernando Brun.

Argentina agreed to work on upgrading India from Annex II to Annex I in its pharmaceutical regulatory framework and progress technical talks on Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) access for Indian agricultural products.

Bilateral trade crossed USD 6.5 billion in 2025 (making India Argentina's 5th largest trading partner), while India's KABIL completed Phase II drilling at its lithium exploration project in Catamarca, Argentina.

national_news.title: Third Vande Bharat Express to Connect Jammu and Srinagar via Udhampur
bullets: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh announced the upcoming launch of the third Vande Bharat Express between Jammu and Srinagar, featuring an approved halt at Udhampur.
The rail line expansion highlights major engineering feats in Jammu and Kashmir, including the world's highest railway bridge constructed over the Chenab River in Reasi district.
The expanded railway connectivity from Jammu to the Kashmir Valley aims to boost regional integration, passenger convenience, and tourism.

national_news.title: Petroleum Ministry Clarifies CBG Pricing Framework Under GOBARdhan Scheme
bullets: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas revised the Compressed Biogas (CBG) procurement price under the GOBARdhan Scheme to ₹2,110 per MMBtu (up from ₹1,478 per MMBtu).
Government provides an affordability support of ₹10 per kg of CBG (~₹215 per MMBtu), bringing the effective net cost down to approximately ₹1,895 per MMBtu.
CBG net cost will be distributed across a 2.5 to 3 times wider domestic gas pool to prevent price hikes for CNG and household PNG consumers.

national_news.title: National Sports Day Observed Nationwide to Commemorate Major Dhyan Chand
bullets: National Sports Day celebrated nationwide on the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand under the call 'Ek Ghanta Khel Ke Maidan Mein'.
Union Budget 2026-27 allocated over ₹4,400 crore to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, a significant increase from ₹1,200 crore in 2013-14.
Key sports milestones highlighted include 29 medals at the Paris 2024 Paralympics, 6 medals at the Paris 2024 Olympics, and 107 medals at the 2023 Asian Games.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Embarks on Two-Day Visit to Uzbekistan
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi undertook a two-day visit to Tashkent at the invitation of Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev to boost bilateral strategic ties.
India ranks among Uzbekistan's top 10 trade partners with bilateral trade standing at around $1 billion, driven by potential in medical, mining, and defence sectors.
Bilateral defence cooperation is bolstered by a Joint Working Group established in 2019 and the annual joint military exercise 'DUSTLIK'.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Begins 6-Day Official Visit to the United States
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is undertaking a six-day official visit to the United States, covering key cities including Chicago, Asheville, and New York.
She will lead the Indian delegation at the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting under the US G20 Presidency in Asheville.

The visit includes high-level engagements with corporate CEOs, a visit to the Polsky Center for Entrepreneurship at the University of Chicago, and participating in the NASDAQ bell-ringing ceremony in New York.

national_news.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana Marks Major Milestone in Financial Inclusion
bullets: Launched in August 2014, the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) has crossed over 59 crore accounts with total deposits reaching ₹3.17 lakh crore.
Rural and semi-urban areas account for 78% of the total accounts, with women owning nearly 56% of accounts and over 41 crore RuPay cards issued to account holders.
Driven by the Jan-Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile (JAM) trinity, India's Financial Inclusion Index has improved from 53.9 in 2018 to 67.

national_news.title: Northeast Power Ministers Seek Central Funds for Grid Modernisation and PSDF
bullets: Ministers of the North Eastern Regional Power Committee (NERPC), led by Meghalaya Power Minister Metbah Lyngdoh, urged Union Power Minister Manohar Lal Khattar to provide central funds for modernising the regional power grid.

States requested targeted support under the Power System Development Fund (PSDF) and a larger allocation from the 10% Gross Budgetary Support (GBS) reserved for the Northeast across central ministries.

Priority projects discussed include SCADA/EMS systems, Emergency Restoration Systems (ERS), smart meter check systems, and additional substations to overcome challenging terrain and transmission losses.

national_news.title: Centre Initiates Calibrated Buffer Stock Release of Onions under PSF
bullets: The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution launched calibrated releases from buffer stock to moderate seasonal onion price volatility, supported by an estimated 2025-26 production of over 307 Lakh Metric Tonnes (LMT).
The government set a procurement target of 2 LMT Rabi onion for the Price Stabilisation Fund (PSF) buffer for 2026-27, with 1.21 LMT already procured since May 15.
Buffer stock onions are being retailed at Rs 35 per kg through NCCF, NAFED, Safal, and Kendriya Bhandar outlets, alongside bulk rail transit via the 'Kanda Express' from Nashik to Delhi NCR.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses Khelo India Dialogue Organised by MY Bharat
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the nationwide Khelo India Dialogue via video conferencing, organized by Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat) as part of National Sports Day celebrations across two colleges in every district.

The Prime Minister reiterated the government's commitment to creating a modern sports ecosystem, emphasizing a talent hunt initiative targeting children aged 5 to 15 years to identify their natural athletic aptitudes.
Union Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya highlighted key sports reforms including the National Sports Governance Act, Fit India Movement, and 'Sunday on Cycle' fitness drives.

national_news.title: Onam Harvest Festival Celebrated Across Kerala
bullets: Onam is the major harvest festival of Kerala, celebrated to mark the arrival of the new harvest season and welcome the legendary King Mahabali.
Key cultural traditions of the festival include Ona Pookkalam (floral carpets), Ona Sadya (traditional feast), Vallam Kali (snake boat races), and traditional folk dances.
Special prayers and rituals were conducted across major temples in the state, including Sabarimala, Aranmula, and Guruvayur.

national_news.title: Bihar Puts Six Districts on High Alert Following Nepal Flash Floods
bullets: Bihar placed six districts along the Gandak River basin—West Champaran, East Champaran, Gopalganj, Saran, Muzaffarpur, and Vaishali—under heightened vigilance.
The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) deployed 9 teams in Bihar and 11 in Uttar Pradesh to prepare for potential river overflows.
Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary and Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit chaired high-level review meetings, with Union Home Minister Amit Shah assuring Central assistance.
national_news.exam_tag: BPSC Special Current Affairs - Disaster Preparedness

national_news.title: India Dispatches 10 Tonnes of HADR Material to Flood-Hit Nepal
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi communicated with Nepalese PM Balendra Shah, offering full support and solidarity during the flood disaster.
India dispatched 10 tonnes of Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) supplies along with essential medicines to Nepal.
Top Indian leadership, including President Droupadi Murmu and EAM Dr. S. Jaishankar, pledged full assistance for relief operations.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / BPSC - Disaster Relief & Bilateral Relations

national_news.title: Flash Floods Hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River Affecting Over 100 Indian Pilgrims
bullets: Severe flash floods surged through Nepal's Bhote Koshi River in the Rasuwa region near the Tibet border, triggered by an earthquake that caused an avalanche.
Over 100 Indian citizens and 37 NRIs traveling for the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra were reported missing among nearly 500 affected people.
The deluge caused widespread destruction across Rasuwa, Dhading, Nuwakot, and Chitwan districts, damaging key infrastructure including four permanent bridges.

national_news.title: Bihar Steps Up Preparedness Along Gandak River Basin Amid Flood Threat
bullets: Bihar placed six districts—West Champaran, East Champaran, Gopalganj, Saran, Muzaffarpur, and Vaishali—on high alert due to rising water levels in the Gandak River triggered by flash floods in Nepal.
NDRF teams have been deployed in Gopalganj and Bettiah, with additional emergency response units stationed on standby in Muzaffarpur.
Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit chaired a high-level review meeting in Patna, while Union Home Minister Amit Shah assured full Central NDRF assistance to Bihar.

national_news.title: India Assures Full Humanitarian Assistance to Flood-Hit Nepal
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke to Nepalese counterpart Balendra Shah, assuring full Indian humanitarian assistance following severe flash floods in Nepal.
Indian rescue teams are coordinating closely with Nepalese authorities to support ongoing disaster relief and search operations.
The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu and the Tamil Nadu government established dedicated emergency help desks to assist stranded Indian tourists and residents.

national_news.title: India and Seychelles Discuss MoU for Cooperation in Fisheries and Blue Economy
bullets: Seychelles proposed accelerating a bilateral Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with India focused on fisheries, marine aquaculture, tuna processing, and blue economy cooperation.
The high-level bilateral discussions were led by Seychelles Minister Wallace Cosgrow and India's Department of Fisheries Secretary Abhilaksh Likhi.
During the meeting, India highlighted its key achievements, including achieving a national fish production of 19.7 million tonnes and seafood exports worth USD 8.46 billion.

national_news.title: PM Modi Chairs PRAGATI Review; Demands Strict Quality Audits and Action on Cyber Frauds
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the monthly PRAGATI interaction, reviewing 6 critical infrastructure projects worth over Rs 30,000 crore across railway, road, and power sectors in 9 states.
Raised serious concerns over quality lapses in public construction projects, questioning the effectiveness of third-party audits and suggesting the need for stricter supervision.
Directed targeted prevention campaigns against cyber threats like 'digital arrests', prioritizing education for vulnerable groups like senior citizens and youth.

national_news.title: IMA Issues Health Advisory on H1N1 Surge and Warns Against Antibiotic Misuse
bullets: The Indian Medical Association (IMA) issued a public health advisory regarding the seasonal spike in Influenza A (H1N1) cases, emphasizing that the infection is self-limiting and requires no panic.
Strictly cautioned against over-the-counter consumption of antibiotics like azithromycin, amoxicillin-clavulanate, and cefixime, stressing that antibiotics do not treat viral infections.
Advised public adoption of preventive measures such as frequent handwashing, respiratory hygiene, and mask usage in crowded spaces.

national_news.title: FM Nirmala Sitharaman Highlights India's Growth Story and Digital Ecosystem in Canada
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed the Indian business community in Toronto during a four-day official visit to Canada focused on trade, investment, and financial cooperation.
Highlighted India's position as the fastest-growing major economy, driven by rapid urbanisation, an expanding middle class, and world-class digital financial infrastructure.
Reaffirmed commitment to a future-focused strategic partnership following the bilateral reset agreed upon during the June 2025 G7 Summit.

national_news.title: Regional Rural Banks Register Highest-Ever Net Profit of Rs 10,176 Crore in FY26
bullets: India's 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) achieved a record consolidated net profit of Rs 10,176 crore in FY26, representing a 49% jump from Rs 6,820 crore in the previous fiscal year.
Asset quality reached historic lows with Gross NPAs dropping to 5.3% and Net NPAs to 2.1%, while total business crossed Rs 13.5 lakh crore and the Credit-Deposit ratio hit an all-time high of 75.2%.
Operating across 22,273 branches in 26 states and 3 UTs, RRBs met all Priority Sector Lending targets and opened over 54.98 lakh new Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) accounts.

national_news.title: Home Minister Sets One-Year Target for 100% Implementation of New Criminal Laws
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the National Security Strategies Conference (NSSC) in New Delhi, setting a 100% implementation deadline for the three new criminal justice laws within one year.
The goal is to ensure case resolution up to the Supreme Court level within three years and increase the overall conviction rate by 25%.

Key initiatives outlined include the 'Narcotics Control Vision Document 2026-2029' based on the 'Detect, Disrupt, Destroy' strategy, a quadrilateral border security approach, and integrating platforms like CCTNS, ICJS, NatGrid, and NAFIS.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / Civil Services Polity & Internal Security

national_news.title: National Traders' Welfare Board Conducts 100th Virtual Interaction Meeting
bullets: The National Traders' Welfare Board (NTWB), under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, held its 100th Virtual Conference Interaction Meeting chaired by Chairman Sunil J. Singhi.
The weekly virtual interaction platform was established in July 2024 to facilitate continuous institutionalized dialogue between retail traders and the government.
The platform serves as an accessible mechanism to disseminate information on welfare schemes, receive policy suggestions, and address grievances from small, medium, and large traders.

national_news.title: India pitches as global data centre hub during India-Japan high-level talks
bullets: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal met Japan's Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry, Akazawa Ryosei, in Tokyo to strengthen economic ties across trade, technology, investments, and tourism.
The Indian government announced plans to create a framework exempting high-tech sector companies from mandatory Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification for manufacturing equipment.
India has received $200 billion in investment commitments from global hyperscalers, with Indian semiconductor demand projected to reach $150 billion by 2032.

national_news.title: Supreme Court to set up special bench on OBC creamy-layer criteria plea
bullets: The Supreme Court agreed to consider forming a special bench to hear the Department of Personnel and Training's (DoPT) plea regarding OBC creamy-layer criteria for Civil Services Examination 2025 candidates.

The plea arises from the SC's March 11 judgment in the Union of India vs Rohith Nathan case, which ruled that an October 2004 clarifying letter cannot override the September 8, 1993 Office Memorandum.

The SC previously held that parental salary or income in public or private sector employment cannot by itself determine creamy-layer exclusion without considering post status and wealth tests under the 1993 OM.

national_news.title: PM Modi marks 10-year milestone of Unified Payments Interface
bullets: Unified Payments Interface (UPI), launched in 2016 as a major pillar of India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), completed 10 years of operation.
The interoperable, real-time digital payment system has achieved global recognition and is currently operational across 11 countries.
Finance Ministry data shows annual UPI transaction volume grew from 1.78 crore in 2016-17 to over 24,162 crore in 2025-26, with transaction value expanding to nearly Rs 314 lakh crore.

national_news.title: Union Health Ministry Reassures Public on Seasonal H1N1 Antigenic Drift
bullets: Pan-India surveillance led by MoHFW, ICMR, DHR, and NCDC across 73 VRDL facilities confirmed circulating H1N1 viruses belong to clade 6B.1A.5a2a (subclade D.3.1.1).
ICMR DG Dr. Rajiv Bahl clarified that observed minor genetic changes represent standard seasonal antigenic drift rather than a novel public health threat.
Advisories highlight routine hygiene measures and targeted medical care for vulnerable demographics including the elderly, young children, and immunocompromised individuals.

national_news.title: Bihar Participates in National Conference of I&PR Secretaries in New Delhi
bullets: Bihar Information and Public Relations Department Secretary Naveen Kumar represented the state at the National Conference of Information and Public Relations Secretaries held at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi.
Key topics discussed included the framework for WAVES 2027, 'WAVES Bazaar', capacity building via the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC), and the 'India Cine Hub' single-window portal.
Deliberations covered the digital transition of media registration through the Press Sewa Portal under the Press and Registration of Periodicals (PRP) Act, 2023.
national_news.exam_tag: BPSC / Bihar State Governance & Central Initiatives

national_news.title: MoHFW and ICMR Monitor Seasonal Influenza Trends via Pan-India VRDL Network
bullets: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), along with DHR, ICMR, and NCDC, is monitoring national respiratory illness trends through 73 Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratories (VRDLs).
ICMR Director General Dr. Rajiv Bahl confirmed that circulating Influenza A (H1N1) matches the A/Missouri/11/2025 (H1N1) pdm09-like virus, classified under clade 6B.1A.5a2a and subclade D.3.1.1.
Genomic surveillance indicates routine antigenic drift consistent with standard seasonal behavior, with no evidence of a new or high-risk influenza strain.

national_news.title: India Post Launches Upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa Applications
bullets: Union Minister of Communications Jyotiraditya M. Scindia launched the upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa mobile apps along with inaugurating 14 renovated post office buildings across India.
The applications were developed indigenously by the Centre for Excellence in Postal Technology (CEPT) under the Advanced Postal Technology (APT) platform as part of DoP IT 2.0 Modernization.
Dak Sewa provides unified postal services across 23 Indian languages, while Dak MITRA equips postal personnel with digital tools for doorstep service delivery.

national_news.title: AIIA Launches 'Garbhini Mitra' Maternal Care Skill-Development Course
bullets: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi, launched the 'Garbhini Mitra' course, a six-month offline healthcare skill-development training program for maternal care.
The program integrates classical Ayurvedic frameworks—Garbhadhana Vidhi, Garbhini Paricharya, and Sutika Paricharya—with modern non-clinical healthcare protocols like Basic Life Support (BLS).
Eligible for candidates completing Senior Secondary (10+2) education, the course aims to create community healthcare guides for holistic antenatal, postnatal, and pre-conceptional support.

national_news.title: Puducherry Government Introduces Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026
bullets: The Government of Puducherry introduced the Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026 to shift business regulation from permission-based control to a rule-based governance model.
The Bill extends approval exemptions for MSMEs to five years, with a provision for a one-year extension, and introduces auto-generation of Acknowledgement Certificates if not issued on time.
It strengthens 'Invest Puducherry' as a single point of contact for investors and establishes an auto-appeal mechanism for applicants against rejected proposals.

national_news.title: RBI's USD-INR Swap Facility Mobilizes USD 73 Billion in Forex Inflows
bullets: The Reserve Bank of India's special USD-INR forex swap facility launched on June 8, 2026, mobilized total forex inflows of US $73 billion as of August 21, 2026.
FCNR(B) deposits alone accounted for US $65.40 billion, driven by an overwhelming response from Non-Resident Indians (NRIs).
The RBI advanced the closure of the FCNR(B) window from September 30 to August 31, 2026, after achieving its objectives ahead of schedule, comfortably surpassing the 2013 swap scheme.

national_news.title: Union Home Minister Inaugurates 9th National Security Strategies Conference-2026
bullets: Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 9th National Security Strategies Conference-2026 in New Delhi, featuring over 850 hybrid participants.
Directed the integration of AI-based analysis on Multi-Agency Centre (MAC) intelligence platforms to formulate SOPs for national security threats.
Stressed full implementation of the Home Ministry's PRAHAAR scheme, expedited trial in absentia provisions for fugitives, and streamlined UAPA investigations.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Urges Young IFS Trainees to Strengthen Grassroots Global Engagement
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with 50 Officer Trainees of the 2025 Batch of the Indian Foreign Service (IFS) at Seva Teerth.
Advised diplomats to blend India's civilisational strengths with technology, innovation, AI, and gaming to boost global outreach.
Encouraged leveraging the 'Bharat ko Janiye' (Know India) Quiz to engage global youth and promote India as a premier international tourism destination.

national_news.title: ISMA Projects Sugar Price Stabilization Amid Sufficient Domestic Availability
bullets: The Indian Sugar and Bio-energy Manufacturers Association (ISMA) stated that domestic sugar prices are expected to cool off due to adequate stock availability, attributing the recent price surge to speculative and panic buying.
ISMA requested a reduction in the sugar holding limit for traders from 400 tonnes to 200 tonnes to release more stock into the retail market.
The Union Government announced the import of 10 lakh tonnes of sugar as a precautionary measure to maintain comfortable stock levels.

national_news.title: India Targets $1 Trillion Chemical Sector Economy by 2040
bullets: Union Minister for Chemicals and Fertilisers J.P. Nadda announced a strategic target to expand India's chemical sector to $1 trillion by 2040 during a CEO Roundtable in New Delhi.
The government highlighted key sectoral reforms and policy interventions including Bhavya Rasayan, Coal Gasification, Rare Earth Corridors, and the Critical Mineral Mission.
Invest India and the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals outlined plans to establish an institutionalized dialogue mechanism to enhance domestic manufacturing and attract foreign investments.

national_news.title: Union Sports Ministry Launches 'Khelo India Samvad' Initiative
bullets: The Union Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports organized 'Khelo India Samvad – Khel Ki Baat PM Ke Saath' across colleges in Punjab, Haryana, and Chandigarh.
Executed through the Department of Youth Affairs' 'Mera Yuva Bharat' (MY Bharat) portal, the drive connects youth with national sports and fitness goals.
The initiative promotes youth engagement via the MY Bharat Suggestions Box and encourages participation in the Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue (VBYLD) Quiz.

national_news.title: 9th National Security Strategies Conference Inaugurated in New Delhi
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 9th National Security Strategies Conference in New Delhi, calling for AI-based analysis on Multi-Agency Centre (MAC) platforms to build SOPs against security threats.
The Home Minister stressed training officers under the MHA's PRAHAAR scheme, using 'trial in absentia' provisions for fugitives, and taking an integrated approach in UAPA investigations.
Held annually in a hybrid format since 2021 following PM Modi's directives, the conference brings together domain experts and over 850 police leadership delegates.

national_news.title: India to Amend Regulations to Boost Manufacturing Investments from Japan
bullets: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal led a 200-business delegation across Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka to strengthen India-Japan economic partnerships.
Announced regulatory updates within two months to resolve investor issues in key areas like semiconductor equipment manufacturing and automotive components.
Engaged in active dialogues on ethical AI usage, clean energy, healthcare, and leveraging free trade agreements for global market access.

national_news.title: India Calls for Sustained Finance for Land Restoration at UNCCD COP17
bullets: Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav addressed the Ministerial Dialogue at the 17th Conference of Parties (COP17) to UNCCD held in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.
Highlighted India's Green Credit Programme, where credits are awarded after five years of restoration on achieving at least 40% canopy density on degraded land.
Emphasized the use of Sovereign Green Bonds and blended green finance to mobilize capital for drought resilience, compensatory afforestation, and biodiversity conservation.

national_news.title: NSA Ajit Doval Visits Beijing for 25th India-China Boundary Talks
bullets: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval visited Beijing to participate in the 25th round of Special Representatives (SR) talks on border issues with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi.
The SR talks mechanism was established in 2003 to comprehensively address boundary disputes along the 3,400 km India-China border.
Discussions focused on border stability following the 2020 Galwan Valley standoff, reiterating that border peace is a prerequisite for normalizing overall bilateral relations.

national_news.title: India and Russia Review Bilateral Cooperation and $100 Billion Trade Target
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met Russian President Vladimir Putin and co-chaired the India-Russia Inter-Governmental Commission meeting in Moscow with First Deputy PM Denis Manturov.
Both countries highlighted steps to achieve the $100 billion bilateral trade target by 2030, addressing tariff/non-tariff barriers, market access, and payment mechanisms.
Key sectors discussed for expanded cooperation included energy, fertilizers, trade, and nuclear energy ahead of upcoming SCO and BRICS summits.

national_news.title: AAI Seeks Rs 1,200-Crore Approval for New Terminal at Bhubaneswar Airport
bullets: The Airports Authority of India (AAI) has submitted a proposal to the Union Finance Ministry's Public Investment Board (PIB) for constructing Terminal 3 (T3) at Biju Patnaik International Airport in Bhubaneswar.
Estimated at a cost of over Rs 1,200 crore, the proposed T3 will integrate both domestic and international operations under one roof.
The new terminal is designed to handle 8.6 million passengers per annum (MPPA) and will feature six additional aerobridges.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Launches Rs 3,400 Crore Defence Infrastructure Projects in West Bengal
bullets: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh presided over the Bhumi Pujan for five projects of Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers (GRSE) and Yantra India Limited (YIL) worth approximately Rs 3,400 crore in West Bengal.
The infrastructure projects, situated across Kidderpore, Shalimar, Raichak, and Ishapore, aim to enhance domestic shipbuilding capacity, quality maintenance services, and export potential.
GRSE, a Navratna Defense Public Sector Undertaking (DPSU) that has delivered over 100 vessels, is currently manufacturing a cargo ship for Germany under the Make in India initiative.

national_news.title: India Celebrates 3rd National Space Day Highlighting $45-Billion Space Economy Vision
bullets: India celebrated National Space Day on August 23, marking the historic anniversary of Chandrayaan-3's successful landing on the Moon's south polar region in 2023.

Addressing the 3rd National Space Day celebrations in Ahmedabad, leaders emphasized space sector reforms designed to drive India towards a $45-billion space economy and support the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the growing role of private space startups, Gen-Z engineers, and global investment in expanding India's space ecosystem.

national_news.title: Rohit Yadav and Murali Sreeshankar Clinch Gold at World Athletics Continental Tour
bullets: Rohit Yadav secured the javelin throw title with a personal best of 87.68 metres at the World Athletics Silver Level Continental Tour at Kalinga Stadium, Bhubaneswar.
Murali Sreeshankar won the men's long jump title with an 8.07-metre jump, while Ancy Sojan secured victory in the women's long jump with 6.71 metres.
19-year-old Abinaya Rajarajan reclaimed the Indian U-20 national record in the women's 100m event after winning with a timing of 11.34 seconds.

national_news.title: India Must Move from 'Pharmacy' to 'Laboratory of the World': Union Minister Anupriya Patel
bullets: Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare Anupriya Patel addressed the 3rd edition of the IIMA Healthcare Summit on 'Advancing AI in Healthcare' at IIM Ahmedabad.
Highlighted the setting up of Centres of Excellence for AI in healthcare at AIIMS New Delhi, PGIMER Chandigarh, and AIIMS Rishikesh.
Emphasized the ₹5,000 crore Promotion of Research and Innovation in Pharma-MedTech Sector (PRIP) scheme to boost innovation-led industry-academia research collaboration.

national_news.title: Visakhapatnam Hosts BRICS Youth and Sports Ministers' Meetings 2026
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the BRICS Youth Ministers' Meeting and BRICS Sports Ministers' Meeting in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
Delegates from 11 BRICS member countries participated in discussions focused on youth empowerment, skill development, entrepreneurship, and sports cooperation under India's BRICS Presidency 2026.
As part of the visit, international delegates toured the historic Thotlakonda Buddhist heritage site near Visakhapatnam and participated in the 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' tree plantation drive.

national_news.title: Union Home Ministry to Form High-Level Committee for Gorkha Issues
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired a high-level meeting with senior Gorkha leaders and state officials in Sukna, Siliguri.
A high-level committee will be constituted under Interlocutor Pankaj Singh (former BSF Director and Deputy NSA) to address and resolve issues pertaining to the Gorkha community.
Leaders across political lines agreed to work towards a resolution for the Darjeeling Hills, Terai, and Dooars regions within the constitutional framework.

national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Roadmap for Next-Generation Governance and Economic Reforms
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the World Leaders Forum in New Delhi, stating that economic and governance reforms are a commitment and conviction for his administration.
Highlighted the transition from a restrictive regulatory approach to modern policy frameworks like the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme to generate employment and drive growth.
Noted that the International Monetary Fund (IMF) projects India to remain the world's fastest-growing major economy despite global macroeconomic uncertainties.

national_news.title: BRICS Tourism Ministers Adopt 'Jaipur Declaration' Under India's Chairship
bullets: BRICS Tourism Ministers unanimously adopted the Jaipur Declaration during a meeting presided over by Union Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat in Jaipur.
The meeting was centered around the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability' to strengthen intra-BRICS tourism ties.
The declaration focuses on four key priorities: AI & Digital Technology in Tourism, Sustainable Practices, Skilling & Capacity Building, and Seamless Travel Facilitation.

national_news.title: HM Amit Shah Reviews Border Fencing and Proposes Triangular Defense Grid for Siliguri Corridor
bullets: Over 1,129 acres of land handed over to BSF and SSB for border fencing along the India-Bangladesh border in West Bengal to prevent illegal infiltration.
A triangular grid of Army posts in Chopra, Dhubri, and Kishanganj will be set up to protect the strategically crucial Siliguri Corridor ('Chicken's Neck').
Laid foundation stones for projects worth ₹189 crore at SSB Frontier HQ in Siliguri and inaugurated an awareness exhibition on three new criminal laws including Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

national_news.title: India Hosts 14th BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation Ministerial Meeting in Chennai
bullets: The 14th BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Ministerial Meeting was held in Chennai, chaired by Union Minister of State for Science and Technology Jitendra Singh.
Under India's BRICS Presidency, the central theme for STI cooperation was selected as 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
India urged member nations to deepen cooperation in frontier areas such as AI, quantum technology, BioE3 policy, high-performance computing, and innovation financing for the Global South.

national_news.title: Legendary Odia Playback Singer Pranab Patnaik Passes Away at 88
bullets: Renowned Odia playback singer Pranab Patnaik passed away in Bhubaneswar at the age of 88, ending a career spanning over five decades.
He began his playback journey in 1958, sang for over 200 films, and won the Odisha State Film Award seven times.
He was honoured with the prestigious Jayadev Puraskar for his lifetime contribution to Odia cinema and musical heritage.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses Economic Times World Leaders Forum, Emphasizes Economic Growth Momentum
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Economic Times World Leaders Forum in New Delhi, describing India as a global bright spot for growth.
Highlighted the government's shift from a restrictive regulatory framework to a Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) model to boost manufacturing and employment.
Reiterated India's commitment to global shared growth guided by the G20 presidency theme of 'One Earth, One Family, One Future'.

national_news.title: India and Brazil Sign MoU for Bilateral Telecom and ICT Cooperation
bullets: India and Brazil signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to enhance bilateral cooperation in telecommunications and Information and Communications Technologies (ICTs) on the sidelines of the 12th BRICS Communications Ministers Meeting in Pune.
The MoU was signed by Union Minister of Communications Jyotiraditya M. Scindia and Brazilian Minister of Communications Frederico de Siqueira Filho.
Key focus areas include Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), cybersecurity, universal connectivity, emerging technologies, and joint alignment ahead of India's BRICS Chairship in 2026.

national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with Founders and CEOs of 20 Space Startups in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with CEOs and founders of 20 Indian space startups, including Skyroot Aerospace, Agnikul Cosmos, Pixxel, Dhruva Space, Bellatrix Aerospace, and Digantara.
The PM urged startups to expand space technology applications into everyday development areas, such as agriculture, livestock management, dairy, and environmental protection.
He stressed the importance of partnering with Atal Tinkering Labs to foster scientific curiosity among youth and build India into a commercially viable global space hub.

national_news.title: BWF World Championships 2026: Indian Doubles Pairs Advance to Quarterfinals in New Delhi
bullets: Men's doubles duo Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advanced to the quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships 2026 in New Delhi by defeating Malaysia's Junaidi Arif and Roy King Yap.
Women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the quarterfinals after defeating Japan's seventh seeds Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi in straight games.
PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty, and the mixed doubles pair of Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto ended their tournament runs following pre-quarterfinal defeats.

national_news.title: 35th Manipuri Language Day Celebrated Across Manipur
bullets: The 35th Manipuri Language Day was celebrated to commemorate the inclusion of the Manipuri language in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India on August 20, 1992.
The state-level event was held at the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy (JNMDA) in Imphal under the theme 'State Song ‘Sana Leibak Manipur’ for Peace, Unity and Integrity'.
State Home Minister Govindas Konthoujam announced that the government will make concerted efforts to secure Classical Language status for Manipuri before the next year's celebration.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry Calls for Accelerated Talent Identification for 2036 Olympics
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the 63rd Governing Body Meeting of the Sports Authority of India (SAI).
The meeting emphasized an accelerated sports talent hunt across schools, districts, and colleges to build India's athlete pool for the 2036 Olympics.
The Governing Body approved the establishment of the National Coach Accreditation Board to structure coach development.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Forms Five-Member Panel to Investigate Student Protest Violence
bullets: The Supreme Court constituted a five-member High-Powered Enquiry Committee (HPEC) headed by former top court judge Justice R Subhash Reddy.
The panel will independently examine allegations of excessive police force and violence by protesters during nationwide student demonstrations.
The HPEC has been directed to submit periodic interim reports, prioritizing targeted violence and harassment of female protesters.

national_news.title: 35th Manipuri Language Day Celebrated
bullets: The 35th Manipuri Language Day was celebrated across Manipur to commemorate the inclusion of the Manipuri language in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution on August 20, 1992.
The state-level event was held at the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy (JNMDA) in Imphal under the theme 'State Song ‘Sana Leibak Manipur’ for Peace, Unity and Integrity'.
The State Home Minister announced government efforts to secure Classical Language status for Manipuri before the next year's celebration.

national_news.title: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand Reach BWF World Championships Quarterfinals
bullets: Indian women's doubles badminton pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi.
Defeated seventh seeds Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi of Japan in straight games (21-16, 21-12).
Other top Indian shuttlers like P V Sindhu, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy, and Chirag Shetty also feature in the tournament.

national_news.title: Mansukh Mandaviya Calls for Accelerated Talent Identification for 2036 Olympics
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the 63rd Governing Body Meeting of the Sports Authority of India (SAI).
Emphasized a comprehensive sports talent hunt across schools, districts, and colleges to build India's athlete pool for the 2036 Olympics.
The Governing Body approved the establishment of the National Coach Accreditation Board for structured coach development.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Forms Five-Member Panel to Probe Student Protest Violence
bullets: Supreme Court constituted a five-member High-Powered Enquiry Committee headed by former top court judge Justice R Subhash Reddy.
The committee will independently examine allegations of violence during student demonstrations at Jantar Mantar and other locations.
The bench comprised Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi, and Justice V Mohana.

national_news.title: Centre Unveils Delhi Master Plan 2047 for Sustainable Urban Growth
bullets: Union Government unveiled the Delhi Master Plan 2047 to transform the national capital into a world-class, inclusive, and economically vibrant city for 3.2 crore people.
The plan aligns with the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047 and adopts area-based redevelopment for brownfield areas and Right Of Way-based planning for greenfield areas.
Union Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal stated that around 40 lakh new affordable housing units will be added in the coming years.

bihar_news.title: West Bengal Launches 'Seva First' Innovation Challenge for Eastern Zone
bullets: The West Bengal government launched the 'Seva First Innovation Challenge – Eastern Zone' inviting innovators from West Bengal, Bihar, and Jharkhand.
The initiative is organized by the Department of Science & Technology and Biotechnology (DSTBT) under the 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan 2026'.
Focus areas include healthcare access, agricultural losses, water shortages, waste management, and disaster preparedness across two categories (Junior and Open).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Health Department Directs 100% Digital OPD Registration in Government Hospitals
bullets: The Bihar Health Department directed all government hospitals to ensure 100 per cent digital registration of patients in outpatient departments (OPDs) using ABHA-based registration and electronic health records (EHRs).
During a review meeting chaired by Health Secretary Kumar Ravi, mandatory registration through the Bhavya portal was also instituted for patients admitted to inpatient departments.

The department reviewed key health initiatives, including the TB-Free Bihar and Anaemia-Free Bihar campaigns, maternal and child healthcare, and upgradation plans for district and community health centres.

bihar_news.title: Surge in Demand for GI-Tagged Marcha Chuda from West Champaran, Bihar
bullets: Demand for the aromatic 'Marcha Chuda' (flattened rice from West Champaran) has surged domestically and internationally following its GI tag.
The variety is known for its unique aroma, black peppercorn-like grain shape, and organic cultivation methods using traditional techniques in Champaran farmlands.
It is currently priced at around Rs 150 per kilogram and is being transported to states like Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Odisha, Uttarakhand, and Jharkhand.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Chief Minister Inaugurates 'Viksit Bihar' Brainstorming Session
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory inaugurated the 'Viksit Bihar: Foundation to Construction' brainstorming session at Bapu Sabhagar in Patna.
Highlighting financial growth, Bihar's 2024 budget reached Rs 3.17 lakh crore, surpassing Jharkhand's budget of Rs 1.39 lakh crore.
Key initiatives highlighted include 700 model schools, academic sessions in 211 degree colleges, and the 'Vidyarthi Saathi' app for digital learning.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Implement Pay Scale for Non-Financed Education Workers
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister announced the implementation of a pay scale for non-financed education workers and teachers, with a committee headed by the Chief Secretary already working on it.
The state government has disbursed Rs 18,000 crore through the Student Credit Card scheme to support higher education.
A total of 700 model schools currently cater to 3.5 lakh children, while 1.42 lakh students are being taught through the Vidyarthi Saathi app.

bihar_news.title: Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory Highlights Bihar's Economic and Educational Growth
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory inaugurated the 'Viksit Bihar: Foundation to Construction' brainstorming session and 'Lav-Kush Pratibha Samman Samaroh' in Patna.
Highlighted the state's budget growth, stating Bihar's 2024 budget reached Rs 3.17 lakh crore, surpassing Jharkhand's Rs 1.39 lakh crore budget.
Informed that academic sessions commenced in 211 degree colleges simultaneously on July 15, with 700 model schools and 75,000 teachers connected via the 'Vidyarthi Saathi' app.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Launches National Innovation Challenge and Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Car Rally
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the National Innovation Challenge under the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan and flagged off the Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Car Rally.
The state government set a target of establishing 10,000 industries in Bihar over the next five years, with land already allocated to around 1,000 industrial units.
The government launched initiatives such as the Vidyarthi Sathi app for competitive exam preparation and established 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan model schools.

bihar_news.title: India Ranks 131st in Global Gender Gap Index 2026
bullets: The World Economic Forum released the Global Gender Gap Index 2026 on September 16, 2026.
India ranked 131st out of 145 countries, with its position remaining unchanged from the previous edition.
India recorded an overall gender parity score of 64.5%, with Educational Attainment as its strongest dimension (96.6%) and Economic Participation and Opportunity as its weakest dimension (41.2%).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Horticulture Development Society Issues RFP for Farm-Level Solar Crop Dryers
bullets: The Bihar Horticulture Development Society (BHDS), under the Department of Agriculture, has floated a tender to empanel OEMs for supplying and installing solar crop dryers across six capacity categories (20 kg to 1,000 kg).
The solar dryers are customized for target groups ranging from individual farmers and kitchen gardens (20–25 kg) to SHGs, FPOs, and large processing clusters (50 kg to 1,000 kg).
Systems must feature indirect forced convection with food-grade SS 304 trays, solar DC fan air circulation, and controlled drying temperatures between 40°C and 70°C.

bihar_news.title: Taruwar Agro: Turning Bihar's Banana Waste into a Rs 2.5 Crore Enterprise
bullets: Founded by three MBA graduates (Jagat Kalyan, Satyam Kumar, and Nitish Kumar Verma), Taruwar Agro Industries utilizes banana plant waste to manufacture fiber-based products like file folders, yoga mats, and baskets.
The company also produces vermicompost and plant nutrition liquid from remaining plant parts, recording a revenue of approximately Rs 2.5 crore in FY26.
The initiative provides supplemental income to local farmers post-harvest and generates employment opportunities within Bihar.

bihar_news.title: AIMIM delegation raises Seemanchal highway alignment and AMU Kishanganj funds with Union Ministers
bullets: An AIMIM delegation led by Asaduddin Owaisi met Union Minister Nitin Gadkari to discuss the Morgram–Malda–Murshidabad–Siliguri Four-Lane National Highway Project alignment through Barsoi in Katihar district.
The leaders demanded the construction of permanent RCC bridges and ghats connecting Bihar with West Bengal.
In a meeting with Education Minister Pralhad Joshi, the delegation urged the release of pending ₹90 crore for the AMU Kishanganj Centre and the sanction of teaching posts.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Pulls Up States Over Menstrual Hygiene Compliance in Schools
bullets: The Supreme Court expressed dissatisfaction with States and Union Territories over compliance reports regarding menstrual hygiene facilities in schools.

The bench of Justices JB Pardiwala and R Mahadevan examined affidavits in the case 'Jaya Thakur v. Government of India & Ors. (2026)', highlighting data discrepancies in states like Jharkhand and Bihar.

The Court oversees the implementation of the Union government's Menstrual Hygiene Policy for School-going Girls in Classes 6 to 12, mandating gender-segregated toilets, free sanitary napkins, and proper waste-disposal systems.

bihar_news.title: ISMA Estimates India's Residential Rooftop Solar Potential at 132 GW
bullets: According to an ISMA report, India's residential rooftop solar market has a total potential of 132 GW, with about 115 GW yet to be deployed.
The PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana launched in February 2024 has been a primary catalyst, contributing around 13.45 GW of rooftop solar capacity by July 2026.
As of August 2026, about 77.85 lakh households registered under the scheme with 14,953 MW of installations completed, led by Gujarat, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Kerala, and Rajasthan.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Distributes Gratuitous Flood Relief via Direct Benefit Transfer
bullets: The Bihar government initiated the direct distribution of Gratuitous Relief (GR) financial assistance to flood-affected families across the state.
The assistance was transferred seamlessly into the bank accounts of beneficiaries using Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to ensure transparency.
A special relief distribution event was organized in Patna to oversee the financial disbursement to affected households.

bihar_news.title: Union Agriculture Minister Visits Bihar to Assess Flood Damage
bullets: Union Minister for Agriculture Shivraj Singh Chouhan visited Bihar on September 16 to assess the overall flood situation and evaluate crop damage.
Conducted aerial surveys of flood-affected areas including Dighwara, Maner, Navgachia, and interacted with affected farmers and people in relief camps.
Held a high-level review meeting on flood disaster management and relief works with Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary at the Secretariat.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets Drone-Based Crop Spraying Across 2.85 Lakh Acres with Rs 11.81 Crore Subsidy
bullets: Bihar set a target to cover 2,85,160 acres under drone-based crop spraying during 2026-27 across all 38 districts under the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana.
The state government sanctioned Rs 11.81 crore in subsidies to provide affordable drone spraying of agricultural inputs like liquid fertilisers and pesticides.
Registered farmers on the DBT portal can avail subsidies for up to 15 acres per crop season under the state's Fourth Agriculture Road Map.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Opens 211 Government Degree Colleges in a Single Day
bullets: Bihar established a landmark in higher education by opening 211 government degree colleges in a single day across blocks that previously lacked degree institutions.
The total number of constituent degree colleges in the state has increased from 272 to 483, covering all 534 blocks.
The initiative falls under the 'Unnat Shiksha, Ujjwal Bhavishya' resolution of Saat Nischay-3 to improve rural access to higher education.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Plans Nine Jaggery Units in Muzaffarpur
bullets: Bihar government is establishing nine jaggery-making units in Muzaffarpur district under the Fourth Agriculture Roadmap and State Jaggery Industry Promotion Programme.
Out of the nine units, six are allocated for the general category and three for the Scheduled Caste category.
Eligible entrepreneurs and farmers will receive a government subsidy of up to 50% on project costs ranging from ₹12 lakh to ₹1 crore.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Power Approves Power Export Up to 654 MW to Nepal
bullets: The Ministry of Power approved the export of up to 654 MW of electricity to Nepal from September 13 to December 31, 2026.
Power is permitted for 18 hours daily (00:00 to 18:00 hours) via Muzaffarpur-Dhalkebar and Tanakpur-Mahendranagar transmission lines.
The emergency measure aims to assist Nepal following severe damage to its domestic hydropower infrastructure caused by devastating flash floods.

bihar_news.title: Indian Civic Bodies Projected to Raise ₹10,000 Crore via Green Municipal Bonds
bullets: Domestic rating agency Icra projects civic bodies to raise ₹10,000 crore through green municipal bonds over the next 30 months (FY2027-FY2030).
Total urban infrastructure investments are pegged at over ₹56 lakh crore during FY27-30, with up to ₹3 lakh crore expected from commercial debt financing.
Qualifying sectors for green municipal bonds include water supply, sewerage, solid waste management, renewable energy, and climate-resilient infrastructure.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Focuses on Cultural Traditions and Educational Infrastructure Growth
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary participated in Shri Ganesh Utsav Puja organized by the Maharashtra Mandal in Patna.
An orientation program for 2,451 newly appointed assistant professors was inaugurated to strengthen the state's educational landscape.
The state government has initiated significant academic expansion, including opening 211 degree colleges in a single day.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Chief Minister Urges Assistant Professors to Ensure 75% Student Attendance
bullets: Bihar Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary addressed newly appointed assistant professors, urging them to ensure at least 75% student attendance in degree colleges.
The state government recently established 211 new degree colleges and appointed 2,451 assistant professors to expand higher education infrastructure, particularly in rural areas.
Highlighted that Bihar spends over 21% of its total state budget on the education sector, spanning primary, secondary, and higher education.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Send 100 Professors to Oxford for Advanced Training
bullets: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary announced an initiative to select and send 100 university professors for capacity-building training at Oxford University and other global institutions.
The announcement was made during the orientation program for 2,451 newly appointed assistant professors across 211 newly established degree colleges.
The Chief Minister highlighted that Bihar allocates 21% of its total state budget to education and became the first state in India to launch 211 degree colleges in a single day.

bihar_news.title: Monolithisch India Secures Quartzite Block in Bihar's Nawada for Rs 157 Crore
bullets: Monolithisch India secured a quartzite stone block in Bihar's Nawada district through an e-auction conducted by the state Mines and Geology Department for Rs 157 crore.
The block has been allotted for a 5-year lease with an approved annual mining capacity of 7,10,000 metric tonnes (MT), totaling 35.5 lakh MT over the lease period.
The acquisition enables raw material backward integration for producing premixed ramming mass, a crucial refractory material for induction furnaces in secondary steel plants.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Launch Month-Long 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' Across All Districts
bullets: Bihar Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit chaired a high-level review meeting to finalize preparations for the state-wide 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan', scheduled from September 17 to October 17, 2026.

The campaign encompasses 13 key components, including 'Aashirwad ka Diya' (lamp distribution via Jeevika and PDS), 'Seva Chitra' school competitions, and 'Aangan ka Milan' honoring Anganwadi and ASHA workers.

Key public mobilization activities include 'Seva Jyoti Yatra' rallies with 'Mera Yuva Bharat' volunteers taking the 'Viksit Bharat 2047' pledge, alongside 'Seva Mera Yogdan' sanitation and conservation drives across assembly constituencies.

bihar_news.title: BREDA Invites Bids for 500 MW Rooftop Solar on Govt Buildings via RESCO Model
bullets: Bihar Renewable Energy Development Agency (BREDA) launched a tender to empanel developers for 500 MW grid-connected rooftop solar projects across government buildings.
The project will adopt the Renewable Energy Service Company (RESCO) model, requiring no upfront capital investment from state building owners.
Empanelled Solar Power Developers (SPDs) will handle the design, installation, commissioning, and long-term operation and maintenance of the solar plants.

bihar_news.title: Demographic Dividend Divergence Across Indian States Highlighted by NFHS-6
bullets: According to the sixth National Family Health Survey (NFHS-6), India's Total Fertility Rate (TFR) stands at 2.0, with only Bihar and Meghalaya remaining above the replacement level of 2.1.
The demographic contribution to India's per-capita income growth is projected to peak around 2031 at 2.1 percentage points before disappearing by 2061.

By 2051, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar are expected to add 132 million and 111 million working-age citizens respectively, accounting for over 100% of India's net working-age gain due to declines in southern states.

bihar_news.title: Prayas Group Recommends 40% Technical Minimum Operational Level for Thermal Power in Bihar
bullets: Energy policy think-tank Prayas submitted recommendations to the Bihar Electricity Regulatory Commission (BERC) regarding the draft Bihar Electricity Grid Code 2026.
It urged BERC to recognize a 40% technical minimum operational capability for coal plants instead of 55%, aligning with Central Electricity Authority (CEA) 2023 regulations.
The group recommended structuring grid tariffs and peak/off-peak hours based on 'net load' to accommodate higher integration of variable solar and wind power.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Partner with Google India to Train School Teachers in AI Skills
